items.title: 〈美股盤後〉溫和CPI消除升息疑慮 費半強漲近2.5% 記憶體類股噴高
paras: 美國7月通膨略為降溫，強化聯準會9月維持利率不變的預期，加上AI基礎設施及記憶體類股強勢上漲，美股週三 (12 日) 多收高。費半指數勁揚近 2.5%，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，標普500指數漲0.26%，道瓊指數幾乎收在平盤。
美國7月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增3.4%，符合市場預期，低於6月的3.5%；月增率則為0.1%。通膨持續降溫後，交易員轉而押注聯準會9月將按兵不動，扭轉前一日升息與維持利率不變機率約各半的局面。
不過，美國通膨率仍高於聯準會2%目標，加上中東局勢持續推高能源價格及美債殖利率，使聯準會官員對是否升息仍存在分歧。
美國與伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽的談判持續陷入僵局。美方週二對一艘試圖穿越阿曼灣、懸掛巴拿馬國旗的船隻開火，進一步加劇市場對原油供應的擔憂，布蘭特原油期貨一度逼近每桶90美元。
油價上漲也推高美國汽油價格。全美普通汽油平均價格週三升至每加侖4.03美元，較一個月前上漲約0.16美元，創歷年8月中旬同期新高。
美股週三 (12 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭盡墨。Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.38%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.87%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 微跌 0.08%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.83%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.82%；博通 (AVGO-US) 微跌 0.01%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.03%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 大漲 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.24%。
記憶體與儲存類股同步走高。美光科技 (MU-US) 大漲 4.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 3.69%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 勁揚 5.76%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 大漲 7.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.01%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.68%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.63%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.95%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
溫蒂漢堡 (WEN-US) 瘋漲14.70%至每股 8.66 美元，英國《金融時報》引述消息人士報導，億萬富豪投資人Nelson Peltz 旗下 Trian Fund Management 正準備提出收購要約，計劃將溫蒂漢堡私有化。
全球AI伺服器大廠美超微 (SMCI-US) 暴漲19.02%至每股 37.61 美元，其第四季業績優於預期，同時發布樂觀的第一季財測，顯示 AI 伺服器需求仍然穩健。
AI 雲端運算公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 猛升 19.28% 至每股 107.73 美元，公司第二季調整後營業利益率達 5%，優於市場預期，營收較去年同期成長逾一倍。
Nebius Group (NBIS-US) 週三漲幅高逾34% 至每股 259.20 美元。這家 AI 基礎設施公司公布的稅前息前折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 與營收均優於 FactSet 調查的分析師預期，毛利率表現也超出市場預估。
Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) 大幅走高13.63%至每股 932.47 美元，該公司調整後每股盈餘及營收雙雙優於市場預期。受惠於 AI 熱潮，Lumentum股價今年迄今已上漲超過一倍。
華爾街分析
CPI 公布後，市場對聯準會 9 月按兵不動的預期升溫。
摩根士丹利財富管理首席經濟策略師 Ellen Zentner 表示，符合預期的通膨數據，將延續上週就業報告公布後形成的「沒有升息必要」論述。9 月聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議前仍有一輪通膨數據，但除非數字呈現截然不同的走勢，聯準會下月仍可能維持利率不變。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)

items.title: 川普宣布白宮發言人月底離任 萊維特生兩胎後轉任外部顧問備戰期中選舉
items.title_en: Trump Announces White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Leave Post at End of Month
paras: 美國總統川普周三(12日)宣布, 白宮新聞秘書萊維特(Karoline Leavitt)將於8月底離開現職, 理由是希望有更多時間陪伴家人。這項人事異動距離11月3日舉行的美國期中選舉僅約3個月, 也意味著川普政府的核心新聞傳播團隊將在選戰前夕出現重大調整。
川普在Truth Social發文表示, 萊維特將於本月底離開白宮新聞秘書職務, 以便花更多時間陪伴年幼子女與家人, 並稱自己完全理解且尊重她的決定。川普同時表示, 萊維特未來將成為他的「頂級外部顧問」之一, 並在共和黨內繼續扮演具有影響力的聲音, 協助共和黨「改寫歷史」並贏得期中選舉。
萊維特則在社群平台X發文表示, 過去一年半擔任白宮新聞秘書是她一生中最榮耀、也最具冒險性的經歷之一。她並未透露離任後是否會加入特定競選團隊, 但川普已明確表示, 她離開白宮並不代表退出其政治核心圈, 而是轉往白宮之外擔任重要政治顧問。
這項宣布也具有特殊時間背景。2026年期中選舉將於11月3日舉行, 共和黨目前正積極整合川普陣營、共和黨全國委員會及各州候選人的競選策略。Axios 7月報導指出, 川普在白宮內外的主要政治顧問當時已召開會議, 檢視民調、競選訊息及期中選舉策略, 川普的超級政治行動委員會及共和黨全國委員會當時合計掌握約5.3億美元資金, 並開始規劃如何、何時以及在哪些選區投入資源。
萊維特在川普政治陣營中的角色也早已超越傳統白宮發言人。她加入川普2024年總統競選團隊, 之後擔任政權交接團隊發言人, 最終獲川普任命為白宮新聞秘書, 成為美國史上最年輕的白宮新聞秘書。她自川普第二任期開始後, 成為政府對外傳達政策、回應媒體質疑及捍衛川普施政的重要人物。
萊維特近年也成為川普政府高度曝光的政治人物。白宮官方資料顯示, 她直到今年7月仍持續主持白宮例行媒體簡報, 7月23日也在白宮詹姆斯·布雷迪新聞簡報室向媒體說明政府政策及回答問題。
她此次離任與家庭因素也有直接關聯。今年5月, 萊維特宣布生下女兒Viviana, 她與丈夫Nicholas Riccio另育有一名年幼兒子Niko。她在生產前曾開始休產假, 並在5月宣布女兒出生。
萊維特離任後, 白宮將面臨新聞傳播工作的重新布局。她在川普政府第二任期擔任發言人約一年半, 在此期間頻繁代表白宮出席媒體簡報, 並經常成為川普政策與政治立場的主要辯護者。她的離開發生在期中選舉進入最後衝刺前夕, 因此外界也將關注川普會任命誰接替這項高度政治化的職位。
川普目前正積極介入共和黨期中選舉布局。美聯社今年5月分析指出, 川普已更加緊密掌握共和黨提名過程, 並積極為部分候選人背書, 但共和黨在11月大選仍面臨選民對川普第二任期及經濟表現的考驗。共和黨策略人士認為, 川普如何運用政治資源以及如何動員其支持者, 將成為期中選舉的重要變數。
川普近期也持續要求共和黨國會領袖加快推動其政治議程。例如7月底, 川普要求參院多數黨領袖Thune取消8月休會, 留在華府推動一項要求選民提供公民身分證明及投票時出示附照片身分證件的法案, 顯示川普正試圖在期中選舉前進一步凝聚共和黨政治議題。
對川普而言, 萊維特離開白宮雖會造成日常新聞運作上的人事變動, 但她轉任外部顧問後仍將繼續參與共和黨政治工作, 反而可能讓她從政府新聞發言角色轉向更直接的選戰及政治宣傳工作。尤其距離期中選舉僅剩不到3個月, 川普已明確將她定位為協助共和黨贏得選舉的重要政治盟友。
paras_en: US President Trump announced on Wednesday (12th) that White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt will leave her position at the end of August, citing a desire to spend more time with her family.

Trump posted on Truth Social that Leavitt will leave her position as White House Press Secretary at the end of the month to spend more time with her young children and family, and stated that he fully understands and respects her decision.
Leavitt posted on social media platform X that her time as White House Press Secretary over the past year and a half has been one of the most honored and adventurous experiences of her life.

This announcement also has a special timing background. The midterm elections in 2026 will be held on November 3rd, and the Republican Party is currently actively integrating Trump's team, the Republican National Committee, and candidates from various states into their election strategy.

Leavitt's role in Trump's political team has already exceeded that of a traditional White House Press Secretary. She joined Trump's 2024 presidential campaign team, then served as the spokesperson for the transition team, and was eventually appointed as White House Press Secretary, becoming the youngest White House Press Secretary in US history.

Leavitt has also become a highly exposed political figure in recent years. Official White House data shows that she continued to host White House regular press briefings until July of this year, and on July 23rd, she explained government policies and answered questions in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room.

Her decision to leave her position is also directly related to family factors. In May, Leavitt announced the birth of her daughter Viviana, and she and her husband Nicholas Riccio also have a young son Niko.

After Leavitt's departure, the White House will face a reorganization of its news dissemination work. She has served as a spokesperson for the White House for about a year and a half during Trump's second term, frequently representing the White House at press briefings and often becoming the main defender of Trump's policies and political positions.

Trump is currently actively intervening in the Republican Party's midterm election layout. A Reuters analysis in May noted that Trump has tightened his grip on the Republican nomination process and is actively endorsing some candidates, but the Republican Party still faces a test of voters' perceptions of Trump's second term and economic performance in the November election.

Trump has also recently continued to demand that Republican congressional leaders accelerate their political agenda. For example, at the end of July, Trump asked Senate Majority Leader Thune to cancel the August recess and stay in Washington to push through a bill requiring voters to provide proof of citizenship and show a photo ID when voting, showing that Trump is trying to further consolidate Republican political issues before the midterm elections.

For Trump, Leavitt's departure from the White House may cause daily news operations to change, but she will continue to participate in Republican Party political work as an external advisor, and may transition from her role as a government spokesperson to more direct election and political promotion work. With less than three months to go before the midterm elections, Trump has clearly positioned her as an important political ally to help the Republican Party win the election.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉美伊談判陷僵局撐油價 Brent小漲至88.98美元
items.title_en: <Energy After-Hours> US‑Iran Talks Stalled Supports Oil Prices, Brent Up Slightly to $88.98
paras: 布蘭特原油期貨周三(12日)小幅走高, 市場一方面擔心中東航運遭到持續攻擊, 且美伊結束戰事的談判陷入僵局, 另一方面則受到國際能源需求預期下修及美國原油庫存意外增加的壓力, 使油價漲幅受到限制。
布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨終場上漲7美分, 報每桶88.98美元; 美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨同樣上漲7美分, 報每桶83.27美元。
油價走高主要受到中東供應風險支撐。一名伊朗高級消息人士告訴路透, 伊朗與美國目前沒有討論延長停火協議, 因為從德黑蘭的角度來看, 相關協議並沒有明確的開始日期, 因此也就沒有可以「延長」的內容。
XS.com業務發展主管Simon-Peter Massabni表示, 隨著市場越來越懷疑美伊雙方能否很快達成協議, 以緩解中東原油運輸中斷或避免衝突進一步升級, 油價持續受到支撐。
航運安全風險也進一步凸顯中東能源供應面臨的壓力。美國與伊朗支持的葉門胡塞武裝周二分別通報在荷姆茲海峽及曼德海峽附近發生航運攻擊。這兩條水道都是中東石油及天然氣出口的重要運輸通道, 此外蘇伊士運河同樣是全球能源與商品運輸的重要航線。
航運數據顯示, 周二通過荷姆茲海峽的船舶數量降至單周低點, 僅有8艘船隻通過。相較之下, 戰事爆發前每天約有125至140艘船舶通過這條全球最重要的能源運輸水道, 顯示航運中斷程度相當嚴重。
不過, 油價漲勢受到全球原油需求預期下修壓抑。石油輸出國組織(OPEC)在最新月度石油市場報告中, 將2026年全球石油需求增長預測下調至每日58萬桶。
國際能源署(IEA)則進一步下修2026年石油需求預測, 現在預估今年全球石油需求將萎縮每日160萬桶。與此同時, IEA預期今年全球石油供應將減少每日430萬桶, 並估計2026年全球原油市場將出現每日約127萬桶的供應缺口。
Gabelli投資組合經理Simon Wong表示, 在荷姆茲海峽關閉後, 亞洲煉油商難以取得足夠原油供應, 因此降低煉油廠開工率, 在這種情況下, 需求預測遭到下修並不令人意外。市場目前真正需要關注的是需求下降幅度, 以及其中有多少屬於暫時性的需求管理, 又有多少會轉變成永久性的需求破壞。
Wong表示, 戰事結束後, 關鍵問題在於有多少原油需求能夠恢復, 他認為並非所有因供應中斷而消失的需求都會重新回來。
美國原油庫存增加也限制油價漲勢。美國能源資訊署(EIA)周三公布, 美國原油庫存上周意外增加, 並創下2023年1月以來最大單周增幅。
分析師指出, 上周美國原油庫存大增主要受到原油出口異常疲弱以及進口量激增推動。出口下降意味著更多原油留在美國境內, 加上進口增加, 共同推高商業原油庫存。

整體而言, 原油市場目前陷入供應風險與需求疲弱的拉鋸。一方面, 美伊談判陷入僵局、荷姆茲海峽與曼德海峽航運遭受攻擊, 以及中東能源供應可能進一步受阻, 都為油價提供支撐; 另一方面, OPEC與IEA同步下修需求展望, 亞洲煉油商降低開工率, 加上美國原油庫存意外增加, 則限制油價進一步上漲空間。市場後續將持續關注美伊談判進展、荷姆茲海峽航運恢復程度以及全球煉油需求變化, 以判斷供應衝擊究竟會演變成持續性的能源短缺, 或只是短期市場擾動。
paras_en: Brent crude futures edged higher on Wednesday (the 12th), as the market was simultaneously worried about continued attacks on Middle‑East shipping and a stalemate in US‑Iran negotiations to end the conflict, while also feeling pressure from a downgrade in global energy demand forecasts and an unexpected rise in US crude inventories, limiting the price gains.
Brent crude futures closed up 7 cents at $88.98 a barrel; US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures also rose 7 cents, ending at $83.27 a barrel.

The price rise was mainly supported by supply‑risk concerns in the Middle East. An Iranian senior source told Reuters that Iran and the United States are not currently discussing an extension of the cease‑fire agreement, because from Tehran’s perspective the deal has no defined start date, and therefore there is nothing to “extend.”

Simon‑Peter Massabni, head of business development at XS.com, said that as the market becomes increasingly doubtful that the US and Iran can quickly reach an agreement to ease disruptions to Middle‑East oil transport or prevent the conflict from escalating further, oil prices remain supported.

Shipping‑security risks also highlight the pressure on Middle‑East energy supplies. US‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces and Iran‑aligned groups reported attacks on vessels near the Hormuz Strait and the Mandeb Strait on Tuesday. Both waterways are key routes for Middle‑East oil and gas exports, and the Suez Canal is likewise a vital global energy and commodity corridor.

Shipping data showed that on Tuesday only eight vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz, the lowest weekly total. By contrast, before the conflict erupted, about 125‑140 ships a day used this crucial global energy corridor, indicating a severe level of disruption.

However, the rally was dampened by a downward revision of global crude‑oil demand expectations. In its latest monthly oil market report, OPEC cut its 2026 global oil‑demand growth forecast to 580,000 barrels per day.

The International Energy Agency (IEA) further trimmed its 2026 oil‑demand outlook, now estimating a contraction of 1.6 million barrels per day for this year. At the same time, the IEA expects global oil supply to fall by 4.3 million barrels per day this year and projects a supply gap of about 1.27 million barrels per day in 2026.

Gabelli portfolio manager Simon Wong said that after the Hormuz closure, Asian refiners struggled to secure enough crude, prompting lower refinery run rates. In that context, a demand‑forecast downgrade is not surprising. The market now needs to focus on the magnitude of demand decline and how much of it is temporary demand management versus a permanent erosion of demand.
Wong added that once the conflict ends, the key question will be how much oil demand can recover; he believes not all demand lost due to supply interruptions will return.

The rise in US crude inventories also capped price gains. The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported on Wednesday that US crude stocks unexpectedly increased last week, marking the largest weekly gain since January 2023.

Analysts said the sharp jump in US crude inventories last week was driven mainly by unusually weak crude exports and a surge in imports. Lower exports mean more crude stays in the United States, and higher imports add to commercial crude stockpiles.

Overall, the crude market is caught between supply‑risk concerns and weak demand. On the one hand, the stalled US‑Iran talks, attacks on Hormuz and the Mandeb, and the risk of further Middle‑East supply disruptions are supporting prices; on the other hand, OPEC and IEA’s joint demand downgrades, Asian refiners cutting run rates, and the surprise rise in US inventories are limiting further price upside. The market will keep watching the progress of US‑Iran negotiations, the restoration of Hormuz shipping, and global refinery demand trends to gauge whether supply shocks will turn into a sustained energy shortage or remain a short‑term market disturbance.

items.title: 中國C919首度跨出國門！為何仍難擺脫波音與空中巴士？
items.title_en: China's C919 Makes First International Commercial Flight, But Challenges Remain
paras: 中國自主研發的C919客機周三(12日)執行首次定期國際商業航班，從北京飛往蒙古烏蘭巴托，象徵中國試圖在波音(BA-US)與空中巴士主導的全球民航市場建立第三種選擇。不過，C919仍高度依賴外國零組件，尚未取得美國及歐洲主要航空監管機構的適航認證，加上產能與售後支援體系仍待提升，短期內撼動兩大巨頭的難度不小。
這架由中國國際航空營運的C919，於當地時間周三下午3時過後從北京首都國際機場起飛，約兩小時後抵達烏蘭巴托。根據中國國航規劃，北京至烏蘭巴托航線未來將每日飛航，這也是C919首度以定期商業航班形式飛出中國領土。
C919由中國國營飛機製造商中國商飛(COMAC)研發，是最多可搭載174名乘客的單走道窄體客機，鎖定與波音737 MAX及空中巴士A320neo相同的市場。此次首航是中國推動國產大型客機走向國際市場的重要里程碑，也延續中國商飛近年積極在海外展示產品的布局。

產能距目標仍遠 關鍵零組件依賴外國供應

儘管C919被視為中國航空工業的重要突破，但其供應鏈仍高度仰賴海外廠商。墨卡托中國研究中心(MERICS)分析師Andreas Mischer指出，C919生產所需的許多關鍵零組件依舊來自外國供應商，其中發動機由美國奇異航太(GE Aerospace)與法國賽峰飛機發動機(Safran Aircraft Engines)合資成立的CFM International製造。
C919也尚未取得美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)或歐洲航空安全總署(EASA)認證，限制中國商飛爭取歐美及其他採認相關標準的海外航空公司訂單。Mischer並指出，中國商飛未能達成「中國製造2025」設定的目標，也就是讓國產大型客機取得中國國內市場10%的市占率。
中國商飛近年持續提升C919的國際曝光度。C919與較小型的C909於2025年11月首度參加杜拜航空展，公司當時表示，希望進一步深化與全球航空產業的關係。
中國是全球最大航空市場之一，為中國商飛提供龐大的本土客戶基礎，但中國航空公司仍離不開波音與空中巴士。今年5月，中國確認訂購200架波音飛機，以及相關發動機與零組件，顯示北京即使大力扶植國產客機，仍須依賴美國製造的商用飛機。
C919目前已累積可觀的積壓訂單，但主要客戶仍是中國航空公司與租賃業者，實際產量也相對有限。截至2025年底，中國商飛累計僅交付32架C919，相較之下，空中巴士光是在2025年就向中國交付約100架窄體客機。今年上半年，中國商飛另交付8架C919，距離2029年達到年產200架的目標仍相當遙遠。

不只要造得出來 售後支援才是競爭關鍵

已退休的航空業分析師Rob Morris表示，中國商飛的研發與生產速度過於緩慢，目前還不足以真正與波音及空中巴士競爭。C919雖有潛力影響兩大巨頭在中國市場的銷售，但執行進度意味著這項衝擊仍須一段時間才會浮現，關鍵在於航空公司與乘客能否接受這款飛機。
Morris指出，飛機製造商不能只負責研發、生產與交付，還必須建立全年無休的服務體系，確保C919的航班派遣可靠度能與市場熟悉且已長期驗證的A320及737相當。這種能力只能透過長時間、持續營運逐步證明。
航空顧問公司AeroDynamic Advisory董事總經理Richard Aboulafia則強調，製造飛機需要所有零件到位，即使短缺的只是扣件，也可能使整架飛機無法完成交付。飛機供應鏈層級繁多，從發動機、機身組件到鑄件、鍛件與扣件，任何環節都可能形成瓶頸。
Mischer認為，中國商飛若要具備全球競爭力，必須先穩固供應鏈、大幅提升產能並建立規模經濟；即使做到這些，要讓結構如此複雜的民航客機完全自主化仍十分困難。
儘管挑戰重重，C919仍是中國航太產業的重要成就。能夠整合龐大零組件、系統及軟體並打造可投入商業營運的客機，本身就是目前全球僅波音、空中巴士等少數業者掌握的能力。此次飛往烏蘭巴托，證明C919跨出了國際化的第一步，但距離真正打破全球民航雙雄格局仍有很長的路。
paras_en: China's domestically developed C919 aircraft made its first international commercial flight on Wednesday, flying from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. This marks China's attempt to establish a third option in the global commercial aviation market dominated by Boeing (BA-US) and Airbus. However, the C919 still relies heavily on foreign components, has not obtained certification from major aviation regulatory bodies in the US and Europe, and its production capacity and after-sales support system need to be improved, making it difficult to challenge the two giants in the short term.

The C919, operated by China International Airlines, took off from Beijing Capital International Airport at 3 pm local time on Wednesday and arrived in Ulaanbaatar about two hours later. According to China National Aviation Corporation's plans, the Beijing-Ulaanbaatar route will operate daily in the future, marking the C919's first regular commercial flight outside China.

The C919 is developed by China's state-owned aircraft manufacturer, COMAC (China Commercial Aircraft Corporation), and can carry up to 174 passengers. It targets the same market as Boeing's 737 MAX and Airbus's A320neo. This flight is an important milestone for China's push to promote domestic large aircraft on the international market, and it continues China Commercial Aircraft's efforts to showcase its products overseas in recent years.

Despite being considered a major breakthrough for China's aviation industry, the C919's supply chain still relies heavily on foreign suppliers. Andreas Mischer, an analyst at the MERICS (Mercator Institute for China Studies) in Germany, pointed out that many critical components needed for the C919's production still come from foreign suppliers, including the engine, which is manufactured by CFM International, a joint venture between GE Aerospace (USA) and Safran Aircraft Engines (France).

The C919 has not yet obtained certification from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) or the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), limiting China Commercial Aircraft's ability to secure orders from overseas airlines that adopt similar standards. Mischer also noted that China Commercial Aircraft has not yet achieved its goal of 'Made in China 2025,' which aims to have domestic large aircraft account for 10% of the Chinese market.

China Commercial Aircraft has been increasing the international exposure of the C919 in recent years. The C919 and its smaller cousin, the C909, made their debut at the Dubai Airshow in November 2025, with the company expressing its desire to further deepen its relationships with the global aviation industry.

China is one of the world's largest aviation markets, providing a massive domestic customer base for China Commercial Aircraft. However, Chinese airlines still rely heavily on Boeing and Airbus. In May this year, China confirmed an order for 200 Boeing aircraft, including engines and components, indicating that Beijing still needs to rely on US-made commercial aircraft despite its efforts to promote domestic aircraft.

The C919 has accumulated a significant backlog of orders, but its main customers are still Chinese airlines and leasing companies. The actual production volume is relatively limited. As of the end of 2025, China Commercial Aircraft had delivered only 32 C919s, compared to Airbus's delivery of around 100 narrow-body aircraft to China in 2025 alone. In the first half of this year, China Commercial Aircraft delivered another 8 C919s, leaving a long way to go to reach its target of producing 200 C919s per year by 2029.
It's not just about producing it; after-sales support is the key to competition

Retired aviation analyst Rob Morris pointed out that China Commercial Aircraft's research and development and production pace are too slow, and it is still not competitive with Boeing and Airbus. Although the C919 has the potential to impact the sales of the two giants in the Chinese market, the execution pace means that this impact will take time to emerge, and the key is whether airlines and passengers can accept this aircraft.

Morris noted that aircraft manufacturers cannot just be responsible for research and development, production, and delivery; they must also establish a year-round service system to ensure the reliability of C919 flight deployments, which should be comparable to the A320 and 737, which have been well-established and verified in the market. This ability can only be proven through long-term and continuous operation.

AeroDynamic Advisory's director general, Richard Aboulafia, emphasized that manufacturing aircraft requires all components to be in place, even if it's just a missing screw, which could prevent the entire aircraft from being delivered. The aircraft supply chain is complex, with multiple levels, from engines, fuselage components to forgings, stampings, and fasteners, and any link can form a bottleneck.

Mischer believes that China Commercial Aircraft must first stabilize its supply chain, significantly increase production capacity, and establish a scale economy to become a global competitor. Even if it achieves these goals, it will still be difficult to completely self-sustain such a complex commercial aircraft.

items.title: 美股大漲引爆退休潮！美銀：「財富效應」讓55歲以上勞工安心退職
items.title_en: US Stocks Surge Sparks Retirement Wave! Bank of America: “Wealth Effect” Lets Workers Over 55 Retire Comfortably
paras: 美銀證券(Bank of America Securities)最新報告指出，美國大量年長勞工正逐步退出勞動力市場，這可能和股市大漲帶來的財富效應有關。
55歲以上勞工的勞動參與率在疫情衝擊後始終未能完全恢復，近期更進一步下滑。2020年2月、也就是疫情正式宣告前夕，美國55歲以上勞工的勞動參與率為40.3%，到了2026年7月，進一步降至36.9%。
美銀證券美國經濟學家Aditya Bhave說：「我們認為，這與過去兩年標普500指數上漲超過35%有關。」這波漲勢可能讓許多原本正在考慮何時退休的人，更容易做出退出職場的決定。
Bhave說：「勞動市場數據一直存在一個謎題。如果縱觀美國經濟，大多數指標在疫情後都恢復得非常好，速度也遠快於我們原本預期。其中一個落後的就是年長勞工的勞動參與率。而過去幾個月，這項指標又進一步下滑。」
不過，Bhave也謹慎表示，不能把年長勞工退出職場完全歸因於股市上漲。
他說：「我不認為有任何單一因素可以完全解釋這個現象。但考量到過去幾年股市的表現，以及自2020年以來的累計漲幅——標普500指數如今已經翻了超過一倍——這種財富增加很可能會讓部分民眾更有誘因退休，因為他們會覺得：『好，我不用工作了。』」
Bhave補充：「這讓人們對退休有相當程度的信心。即使是風險承受度相對較低的人，也擁有相當大的緩衝空間。」

如果股市反轉 他們的財富會怎麼樣？

對此，Bhave表示，即使股市出現回檔，部分退休族可能仍有足夠的財富緩衝。「就這個情況而言，我認為他們擁有足夠的緩衝，因此可能會認為：股市可能出現回檔，但只要不是災難性的崩跌，考量到過去財富已大幅累積，即使股市下跌，我仍然放心退休。」
為接近退休年齡客戶提供服務的理財顧問，對這項分析並不感到意外。《Women and Wealth》一書作者、認證理財規劃師Cary Carbonaro表示，財富效應確實存在。
她說：「我們經歷了2023年、2024年和2025年的兩位數股市漲幅，2026年目前也有望延續這樣的表現。退休潮正在因這些漲幅而發生，這讓我的客戶擁有過去沒有的更多選擇。」
位於堪薩斯州Overland Park的理財規劃師Tyson Sprick也有類似觀察，「螢幕上的數字從來沒有這麼漂亮過，部分客戶因此獲得信心，終於決定退休。」
不過，他也表示，客戶同時會問：「這種情況還能持續多久？」以及「如果股市大跌，我還能安然無恙嗎？」
「因此，我們會把所有這些因素納入考量，根據目前的市場水準採用前瞻性的財務規劃假設。雖然我們無法預測未來，但我們並沒有忽視這項事實：這種強勁報酬不可能永遠持續。」
即使尚未準備退休的民眾，也正受惠於這波市場榮景。根據美銀另一份數據，2026年第2季，401(k)平均帳戶餘額已達12萬4250美元，較一年前增加15%。數據顯示，約三分之二的員工認為，目前的退休儲蓄進度足以讓他們在理想的退休年齡、而且以自己期望的生活方式退休，這個比率較去年增加6個百分點。
paras_en: Bank of America Securities’ latest report says a large number of older U.S. workers are gradually exiting the labor market, possibly linked to the wealth effect from the big stock rally.

The labor‑force participation rate of workers aged 55 and over has never fully recovered after the pandemic shock and has recently slipped further. In February 2020, just before the pandemic was declared, the participation rate was 40.3%; by July 2026 it had fallen to 36.9%.

Bank of America economist Aditya Bhave said, “We think this is related to the S&P 500’s rise of more than 35% over the past two years.” That rally may make many people who were weighing when to retire more inclined to leave the workforce.

Bhave added, “Labor‑market data has always presented a puzzle. Looking at the U.S. economy, most indicators have recovered very well after the pandemic, far faster than we originally expected. One lagging indicator is the participation rate of older workers, and in recent months that metric has slipped further.”
However, Bhave cautioned that the exit of older workers cannot be attributed entirely to the stock‑market rally.

He said, “I don’t think any single factor can fully explain this phenomenon. But given the market performance over the past few years and the cumulative gain since 2020—the S&P 500 has more than doubled—this increase in wealth is likely giving some people a stronger incentive to retire, because they think, ‘Okay, I don’t need to work any more.’”
Bhave added, “This gives people a considerable degree of confidence about retirement. Even those with relatively low risk tolerance now have a sizable buffer.”

If the market reverses, what happens to their wealth? Bhave said that even with a market pull‑back, many retirees may still have enough wealth cushion. “In that situation I think they have sufficient buffer, so they may think: the market might pull back, but as long as it isn’t a catastrophic crash, given the large wealth already accumulated, even if the market falls I’m still comfortable retiring.”

Financial advisors who serve near‑retirement clients are not surprised by this analysis. Cary Carbonaro, author of *Women and Wealth* and a certified financial planner, said the wealth effect is real.

She said, “We have experienced double‑digit stock gains in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and 2026 looks set to continue that performance. The retirement wave is occurring because of these gains, giving my clients more options than they previously had.”

Financial planner Tyson Sprick in Overland Park, Kansas, made a similar observation: “The numbers on the screen have never looked so good; some clients have gained confidence and finally decided to retire.”
He also noted that clients ask, “How long can this situation last?” and “If the market crashes, will I still be okay?”

“Therefore, we take all these factors into account and use forward‑looking financial‑planning assumptions based on current market levels. While we cannot predict the future, we do not ignore the fact that such strong returns cannot last forever.”

Even people who are not yet ready to retire are benefiting from the market boom. According to another Bank of America data set, average 401(k) balances in Q2 2026 reached $124,250, up 15% from a year earlier. About two‑thirds of employees say their current retirement‑savings progress is sufficient to retire at their ideal age and lifestyle, a 6‑point increase from last year.

items.title: DeepSeek不再獨領風騷？Meta、輝達殺入開放模型戰場
items.title_en: Meta and NVIDIA Enter Open Model Market, Challenging China's DeepSeek
paras: 中國AI實驗室近年在開放權重模型市場取得領先後，Meta(META-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)本周相繼推出可供開發者免費下載的新模型，正式加入由深度求索(DeepSeek)、月之暗面(Moonshot AI)及阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)通義千問(Qwen)主導的競爭。業界人士認為，兩大科技公司此舉等於明確宣告，美國不會把接近前沿水準的開放模型市場拱手讓給中國業者。
與OpenAI及Anthropic旗下熱門封閉模型不同，開放權重模型允許開發者下載決定AI運作與行為的參數，進行檢視、調整與部署。不過，開放權重不一定等同完整的開源，因為業者未必會同時公布訓練資料、訓練方法與原始碼。
就在上月，Meta、輝達與其他美國科技公司曾聯名呼籲政策制定者，不要對開放權重模型施加「過早限制」，即使模型來自中國也不例外。這些公司主張，開放權重AI能擴大機會、促進競爭、延續美國科技領導地位，並避免能力集中在少數企業手中。
Meta、輝達接連出招 正面迎戰中國模型
Meta周一發表Muse Glimmer，作為重新向開放生態系統釋出強大模型的策略之一。執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)並宣布，將開放最新模型Muse Spark 1.2的權重。
Muse Spark 1.2被視為可與OpenAI及Anthropic頂尖基礎模型競爭的產品，不過Meta與輝達本周率先發布的模型規模較小，主要設計為在筆電等本地裝置運行，可用於驅動裝置端數位代理。
輝達隔日推出Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，延續去年12月發表的Nemotron 3模型家族。輝達強調，其模型屬於「真正的開源」，因為公司除模型權重外，也公布相關訓練資料集及訓練技術，供開發者檢視。
Box(BOX-US)執行長Aaron Levie形容，祖克柏開放Muse Spark 1.2權重的計畫是「非常重大的事件」，Meta與輝達的最新動作已明確表態，美國將擁有接近前沿水準的開源模型。
Meta先前曾透過Llama進軍開放模型市場，但2025年4月推出的Llama 4未能獲得開發者青睞。公司隨後投入數十億美元重整AI部門，延攬Scale AI執行長Alexandr Wang領導相關業務。近期，Wang團隊陸續以Muse品牌推出封閉模型，試圖開拓新收入來源，如今又重新向開放權重路線靠攏。

政府、銀行商機龐大 Meta仍須挽回開發者信任

Meta與輝達仍須證明，在DeepSeek、月之暗面與通義千問等中國模型已廣受歡迎的市場中，美國開放模型確實能吸引足夠的開發者與企業用戶。
Levie認為，美國企業推出具競爭力的開放權重模型，可望釋放龐大需求。美國政府機構與大型銀行可能因資安、監管及資料主權疑慮，無法採用中國開放模型，但更願意嘗試Meta等本土供應商的產品。這將使Muse有機會進入過去難以觸及的敏感應用場景。
Forrester分析師Charlie Dai也表示，Meta回歸開放權重具有重要戰略意義，因為這讓美國主要前沿AI業者重新回到開放生態系統。對開發者及企業而言，開放權重有助提高透明度、客製化程度、部署彈性與資料自主性。
不過，Meta曾從開放權重轉向封閉模型，已傷害部分第三方開發者的信任。企業AI新創Uniphore執行長Umesh Sachdev表示，Meta當初改變策略，讓旗下開發者感到遭到背叛，祖克柏本周發表長達3,500字的宣言，恐怕仍不足以說服他們重新投入Meta生態系統。
Sachdev仍期待美國本土業者成功，因為更多競爭可望降低AI模型的Token使用成本，同時加快創新，最終讓消費者受惠。Dai則指出，Meta接下來不能只靠發布性能優異的模型，還必須證明有能力建立可長期維持的開發者生態系統。
開放權重AI在美國仍具有政治爭議。批評者擔心中國模型可能帶來國家安全風險，也將「蒸餾」技術視為一種潛在的智慧財產竊取手段；業界則反駁，蒸餾是廣泛用於模型改進、評估及驗證的技術。隨著Meta與輝達加入戰局，美中AI競爭也正從封閉模型效能之爭，進一步延伸至誰能掌控全球開放生態系統。
paras_en: China's AI laboratory has been leading the open weight model market in recent years, but Meta (META-US) and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) have recently released new models that can be downloaded for free by developers, officially joining the competition led by DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, and Alibaba (BABA-US) (09988-HK) (Qwen). Industry insiders believe that the two major technology companies' move is equivalent to declaring that the US will not give up the open model market to Chinese companies.

Unlike the popular closed models from OpenAI and Anthropic, open weight models allow developers to download the parameters that determine AI behavior and operation, allowing for review, adjustment, and deployment. However, open weight does not necessarily mean complete open-source, as companies may not simultaneously publish training data, training methods, and original code.

Last month, Meta, NVIDIA, and other US technology companies jointly called on policymakers not to impose 'premature restrictions' on open weight models, even if they come from China. These companies argue that open weight AI can expand opportunities, promote competition, and extend US technological leadership, while avoiding the concentration of capabilities in a few companies.
Meta and NVIDIA have successively made their moves, directly challenging Chinese models.

Meta announced Muse Glimmer on Monday as part of its strategy to release powerful models back into the open ecosystem. CEO Mark Zuckerberg also announced that the company would open the weights of its latest model, Muse Spark 1.2.

Muse Spark 1.2 is considered a product that can compete with the top-tier base models from OpenAI and Anthropic, but the models released by Meta and NVIDIA this week are smaller in scale and designed primarily for local deployment on devices such as laptops, which can be used to drive device-side digital agents.

NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning the next day, continuing its Nemotron 3 model family released in December last year. NVIDIA emphasized that its model is 'true open-source' because the company has published not only the model weights but also the related training data sets and training techniques for developers to review.

Box (BOX-US) CEO Aaron Levie described Zuckerberg's plan to open Muse Spark 1.2 weights as 'a very significant event', and Meta and NVIDIA's latest moves have clearly stated that the US will have open-source models that are close to the cutting edge.

Meta previously entered the open model market through Llama, but Llama 4, released in April 2025, failed to gain the favor of developers. The company subsequently invested tens of billions of dollars to revamp its AI department, hiring Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang to lead related business. Recently, Wang's team has released closed models under the Muse brand, trying to explore new revenue streams, and now they are returning to the open weight route.
The US government and large banks have a huge market for Meta, which still needs to regain the trust of developers.

Levie believes that US companies can release competitive open weight models, which can unlock huge demand. US government agencies and large banks may be hesitant to adopt Chinese open models due to security, regulatory, and data sovereignty concerns, but they are more willing to try products from domestic suppliers like Meta. This will give Muse a chance to enter previously inaccessible sensitive application scenarios.

Forrester analyst Charlie Dai also stated that Meta's return to open weight has important strategic significance because it allows US leading AI companies to return to the open ecosystem. For developers and enterprises, open weight can improve transparency, customization, deployment flexibility, and data sovereignty.

However, Meta has previously switched from open weight to closed models, which has damaged the trust of some third-party developers. Uniphore CEO Umesh Sachdev said that Meta's change of strategy made its developers feel betrayed, and Zuckerberg's recent 3,500-word statement may not be enough to convince them to re-enter the Meta ecosystem.

Sachdev still expects US domestic companies to succeed because more competition can reduce the cost of using AI models and accelerate innovation, ultimately benefiting consumers. Dai pointed out that Meta cannot rely solely on releasing high-performance models in the future, but must also prove its ability to establish a sustainable developer ecosystem.

Open weight AI is still a contentious issue in the US. Critics worry that Chinese models may pose national security risks and view 'distillation' as a potential intellectual property theft method; the industry argues that distillation is a widely used technique for model improvement, evaluation, and verification. As Meta and NVIDIA join the fray, the US-China AI competition is shifting from the debate over closed model performance to who can control the global open ecosystem.

items.title: DeepSeek要挑戰Claude Code！成立AI代理新團隊大舉徵才
items.title_en: DeepSeek Aims to Challenge Claude Code, Launches New AI Agent Team and Aggressively Hires
paras: 中國AI新創深度求索(DeepSeek)正公開擴大對Anthropic旗下熱門程式設計工具Claude Code的挑戰。該公司成立新的AI代理團隊，不僅開設官方社群帳號、發布多項職缺，還升級旗艦模型的代理能力，顯示業務重心正進一步轉向可自動執行複雜工作的AI代理產品。
總部位於杭州的DeepSeek近日在騰訊旗下超級應用程式微信(WeChat)開設「DeepSeek Harness Team」帳號。該帳號隸屬一家位於北京的企業，經騰訊驗證；中國企業資料庫企查查顯示，這家企業由DeepSeek控制。
「Harness」通常指建構在大型語言模型外圍的軟體框架，讓AI代理能夠使用工具、管理工作流程，並完成更複雜的任務。Anthropic等AI開發商已利用這類框架強化旗下產品，使其更有效率地處理程式設計與其他專業工作。Claude Code便是目前最受矚目的AI程式設計代理工具之一。
DeepSeek也開始為Harness團隊招募多個職位。公司在其中一則徵才公告中表示，目標是把旗下模型轉化為最先進的代理型產品，反映其不再只著重基礎模型效能，也準備強化模型與工具、工作流程及實際應用場景之間的整合。
此外，DeepSeek周三晚間透過微信官方聊天頻道宣布，已更新旗艦V4 Pro模型，進一步改善AI代理能力。新團隊成立與模型升級幾乎同步曝光，顯示DeepSeek正加速建立從底層模型到代理應用的完整產品布局。
中國AI業者目前正與美國開發商激烈競爭，希望打造能力更強、成本更低的AI工具。OpenAI的ChatGPT掀起全球生成式AI競賽後，業界焦點已逐漸從聊天機器人轉向AI代理，希望透過能夠理解指令、操作軟體並自主完成多步驟任務的產品，切入企業自動化市場。
相較一般聊天機器人，AI代理具備更明確的商業化潛力，可協助程式設計師、研究人員及其他專業人士自動處理工作，也因此成為中美AI業者新一輪競爭的關鍵戰場。DeepSeek並未在正常營業時間後回應置評請求。
paras_en: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, is publicly expanding its challenge to Anthropic's popular programming tool Claude Code. The company has formed a new AI agent team, opened an official community account, posted multiple job openings, and upgraded the agency capabilities of its flagship model, indicating that its business focus is shifting further toward AI agent products that can automatically perform complex tasks.

Headquartered in Hangzhou, DeepSeek recently opened a "DeepSeek Harness Team" account on Tencent's super app WeChat. The account is affiliated with a Beijing‑based company that has been verified by Tencent; the Chinese business registry Qichacha shows that this company is controlled by DeepSeek.

"Harness" typically refers to a software framework built around large language models that enables AI agents to use tools, manage workflows, and accomplish more complex tasks. AI developers such as Anthropic have used such frameworks to strengthen their products, making them more efficient at programming and other professional work. Claude Code is currently one of the most prominent AI programming agent tools.

DeepSeek has also begun recruiting for multiple positions on its Harness team. In one job posting, the company said its goal is to turn its models into cutting‑edge agent‑type products, reflecting a shift away from focusing solely on base model performance toward tighter integration of models with tools, workflows, and real‑world use cases.

In addition, DeepSeek announced on Wednesday evening via its official WeChat chat channel that it has updated its flagship V4 Pro model, further improving its AI agent capabilities. The near‑simultaneous reveal of the new team and model upgrade shows DeepSeek is accelerating the construction of a complete product stack from underlying models to agent applications.

Chinese AI firms are currently locked in fierce competition with U.S. developers, aiming to create more powerful and lower‑cost AI tools. After OpenAI's ChatGPT sparked a global generative‑AI race, industry attention has gradually shifted from chatbots to AI agents, with the hope of entering the enterprise automation market through products that can understand instructions, operate software, and autonomously complete multi‑step tasks.

Compared with ordinary chatbots, AI agents have clearer commercial potential, helping programmers, researchers, and other professionals automate work, and thus becoming a key battleground in the new round of U.S.–China AI competition. DeepSeek did not respond to comment requests outside of normal business hours.

items.title: 關稅壓力太棘手？蘋果延攬美航老將對接川普政府
items.title_en: Tariff Pressure Too Tricky? Apple Hires Former American Airlines Executive to Liaise with the Trump Administration
paras: 根據外媒周三(12日)報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)延攬美國航空(AAL-US)資深主管蓋頓(Nate Gatten)出任全球政府事務副總裁，借重其深厚的共和黨人脈，協助公司處理與川普政府的關係。隨著關稅與海外生產成為政策焦點，這項任命凸顯蘋果正重新調整政府關係布局。
蘋果資深副總裁暨法務長紐斯特德(Jennifer Newstead)在內部備忘錄中表示，蓋頓將於8月31日上任，常駐加州庫比蒂諾，負責領導蘋果全球政府事務團隊，並直接向她報告。前法務長兼政府事務資深副總裁亞當斯(Kate Adams)則將擔任顧問至10月1日退休。
蘋果政府事務主管一職近年歷經多次調整。相關職責過去由前美國環境保護署(EPA)署長傑克森(Lisa Jackson)掌管，她曾在歐巴馬政府任職，2013年加入蘋果後也負責環境、政策及社會倡議，協助公司推動減碳等目標。
不過，川普兩度執政使這項工作面臨新挑戰，尤其是政府試圖對海外製造產品加徵關稅，恐直接衝擊高度依賴亞洲供應鏈的蘋果。近年來，執行長庫克(Tim Cook)也更親自介入與白宮的關係。
知情人士透露，蘋果希望延攬一名能與川普政府保持一致及順暢合作的人選。蓋頓是共和黨人，2017年起擔任美國航空政府事務主管，直到本周離任；此前曾在摩根大通(JPM-US)領導全球政府關係與政策團隊，也曾在房利美(Fannie Mae)帶領負責與共和黨國會議員溝通的團隊。
蓋頓也具有房地產相關經驗，可望在蘋果擴大零售門市與其他營運據點之際提供協助。他上任後預計與庫克密切合作。現任政府事務主管阿曼(Nick Ammann)則將改向蓋頓報告，團隊其他主管波德利(Tim Powderly)、布朗(Matt Brown)與奧吉爾(Mike Orgill)也將納入其管理。
這項任命是蘋果高層世代交替的最新一環。公司本周也通知員工，長期負責Apple Pay與Wallet服務的主管即將卸任。庫克則預計9月1日把執行長職務交給硬體工程主管特納斯(John Ternus)，自己轉任執行董事長，並繼續參與政府關係事務，包括維繫與川普政府的互動。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Wednesday (the 12th), Apple (AAPL-US) has hired Nate Gatten, a senior executive from American Airlines (AAL-US), as Vice President of Global Government Affairs, leveraging his deep Republican network to help the company manage its relationship with the Trump administration. As tariffs and overseas production become policy focal points, the appointment underscores Apple’s reshaping of its government‑relations strategy.

Apple senior vice president and general counsel Jennifer Newstead said in an internal memo that Gatten will assume the role on August 31, based in Cupertino, California, where he will lead Apple’s global government affairs team and report directly to her. Former general counsel and senior vice president of government affairs Kate Adams will serve as a consultant until her retirement on October 1.

Apple’s government‑affairs leadership has been restructured several times in recent years. The responsibilities were previously held by former EPA administrator Lisa Jackson, who served in the Obama administration and, after joining Apple in 2013, oversaw environmental, policy and social‑impact initiatives, helping the company pursue carbon‑reduction goals.

However, the two‑time Trump administration presents new challenges, especially as the government seeks to impose tariffs on overseas‑manufactured products, which could directly hit Apple’s heavy reliance on Asian supply chains. In recent years CEO Tim Cook has also become more personally involved in relations with the White House.

Sources familiar with the matter said Apple wants someone who can align with and work smoothly with the Trump administration. Gatten, a Republican, has been American Airlines’ head of government affairs since 2017 and left the role this week; he previously led JPMorgan’s (JPM-US) global government relations and policy team and headed a team at Fannie Mae that communicated with Republican members of Congress.

Gatten also brings real‑estate experience that could help Apple as it expands retail stores and other operational sites. After taking the post he is expected to work closely with Cook. Current government‑affairs chief Nick Ammann will now report to Gatten, and other team leaders Tim Powderly, Matt Brown and Mike Orgill will fall under his management.

The appointment is the latest part of Apple’s senior‑leadership generational turnover. The company also told employees this week that the long‑time head of Apple Pay and Wallet will soon step down. Cook plans to hand over the CEO role to hardware engineering chief John Ternus on September 1, become executive chairman, and continue to be involved in government‑relations work, including maintaining interaction with the Trump administration.

items.title: 台泥上半年EPS0.38元 整合土葡非水泥事業Cimpor International申請海外IPO
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement Reports EPS of NT$0.38 for the First Half of the Year, Plans to List Cimpor International on Overseas Stock Exchange
paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(12)日公告上半年財報，純益32.8億元，年增241%，每股純益0.38元；另外，董事會也通過，整合旗下土、葡及非洲等水泥及混凝土建材相關業務，納入新設子公司Cimpor International Holdings，並以該公司為主體，申請於海外證券交易市場首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易。
台泥表示，Cimpor International目前以英國倫敦證券交易所或泛歐交易所作為可能的掛牌市場，台泥也預計於10月13日召開臨時股東會討論Cimpor International海外IPO案。至於全球儲能發展與建置的 NHOA Energy，以及發展歐洲充儲一體業務的 Atlante，不納入本次上市範圍，後續將另行評估。
台泥表示，推動 Cimpor International 海外上市，主要目的在於健全其資本結構、建立更多元的籌資管道，並提升國際資本市場能見度及吸引全球專業人才，透過更清楚的事業定位與獨立籌資能力，預期將有助於歐亞非洲及周邊市場水泥及混凝土建材事業的長期發展，進一步提升集團整體營收及獲利能力。
台泥指出，本次上市預計採取發行新股及轉讓既有股份並行的方式，依上市地相關規範，公眾持股比例預計不低於 Cimpor International 總股本的 10%。實際發行規模、股權比例、價格及交易條件，仍將依資金需求、市場環境、投資人認購情形，以及與主管機關、交易所和證券承銷商的協商結果確定。
台泥強調，Cimpor International 完成上市後，台泥持股比例雖可能因股權分散而有所調整，但仍將透過 TCC Dutch Holdings 維持對 Cimpor International 的控制權，並持續將其納入合併財務報表，另外，OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.的現有營運及其於伊斯坦堡證券交易所的上市地位亦不受影響。
台泥上半年營收達712.9億元，年增1%，毛利率18.2%，年增2.2個百分點、營業利益51.7億元，年增51%，獲利成長主要受惠土葡水泥業務銷售量價同步提升，以及旗下和平電力則因營運天數增加、能量費率上升，均帶動獲利增加。
不過，兩岸水泥業務仍面臨市場挑戰。台灣市場受到房市疲弱及進口水泥影響，加上預拌混凝土銷量減少，銷量及毛利率下降；中國大陸市場則因供需失衡及競爭加劇，水泥價格與毛利皆承壓。
截至2026年第二季底，台泥總資產為5,960億元、總負債為2,966億元，負債占總資產比率約49.8%，整體財務結構維持穩健。台泥表示，面對全球產業環境變化，公司將持續強化低碳建材、能源事業及國際市場布局，提升營運效率與財務韌性，穩健推進企業轉型。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) announced its first-half financial report today, with a net profit of NT$3.28 billion, a year-on-year increase of 241%, and an EPS of NT$0.38. The board of directors also approved the integration of its cement and concrete products businesses in Taiwan, Portugal, and Africa into a new subsidiary, Cimpor International Holdings, which will be listed on an overseas stock exchange.

Taiwan Cement stated that Cimpor International is currently considering listing on the London Stock Exchange or the Euronext exchange, and the company plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on October 13 to discuss the listing of Cimpor International. NHOA Energy and Atlante, which are involved in energy storage and charging infrastructure, respectively, will not be included in the initial public offering (IPO) and will be evaluated separately.

Taiwan Cement stated that the main purpose of listing Cimpor International is to strengthen its capital structure, establish a more diversified funding channel, and enhance its visibility and attractiveness to international capital markets. This is expected to help the company's long-term development in the cement and concrete products markets in Europe, Asia, Africa, and surrounding regions, and to improve the company's overall revenue and profitability.

Taiwan Cement stated that the listing will be done through the issuance of new shares and the transfer of existing shares, with a public float of at least 10% of Cimpor International's total shares. The actual issuance size, shareholding ratio, price, and trading conditions will be determined based on the company's funding needs, market environment, investor subscription, and discussions with regulatory authorities, exchanges, and underwriters.

Taiwan Cement emphasized that even after the listing, the company will maintain control over Cimpor International through TCC Dutch Holdings and will continue to consolidate its financial statements. The listing will not affect OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.'s existing operations or its listing on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.

Taiwan Cement's first-half revenue reached NT$71.29 billion, a year-on-year increase of 1%, with a gross margin of 18.2%, a year-on-year increase of 2.2 percentage points, and an operating profit of NT$5.17 billion, a year-on-year increase of 51%. The company's profitability growth was mainly driven by the increase in sales volume and price of cement and concrete products in Taiwan and Portugal, as well as the increase in operating days and energy prices at its Ande Power plant.

However, the company's cement business in Taiwan and China faces market challenges. The Taiwanese market is affected by the weak housing market and the impact of imported cement, while the Chinese market is affected by supply-demand imbalances and increased competition, leading to downward pressure on cement prices and margins.

As of the end of the second quarter of 2026, Taiwan Cement's total assets were NT$596 billion, with total liabilities of NT$296.6 billion, representing a debt-to-asset ratio of approximately 49.8%. The company stated that it will continue to strengthen its low-carbon materials, energy, and international business, improve operational efficiency and financial resilience, and promote a stable transformation of the company.

items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile to Spend Up to NT$29.13 Billion, Paying a 29.5% Premium, to Acquire a Controlling Stake in Systex
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。
林之晨認為，此次公開收購精誠股權，希望在AI時代裡，透過雙方深度的ICT結盟，整合資訊IT與電信CT，創造「跨售」、「AI」與「區域化」三大綜效，目標在資服產業的市占率能夠從7%，倍增至14%，進一步推升台灣大在4、5年後營收可達千億規模。
林之晨指出，此次公開收購的對價為一半現金、一半換股，應賣1股精誠普通股，可換取台灣大普通股0.84股及現金92.5元。
若以台灣大及精誠今天收盤價計算，相當於每股收購價約當184.5元，溢價約29.5%；以近一季平均收盤價計算，溢價則約32.5%；以近半年收盤價計算，溢價約38.5%。
台灣大說明，此次目標取得至少39%、最高58%精誠資訊股權，全案收購價金為195.8億元至291.3億元。另外，此次收購所需對價總數為台信電訊持有台灣大普通股89186829股到132636822股(約占台灣大2.4至3.6%股權)，現金對價總額為98.21至146.06億元，將以自有資金及台灣大集團內部關係人借款支應。
林之晨提到，此次公開收購預計8月18日開始，目標50天內完成，須向公平會申請並獲得通過，且收購股份需達39%，待2項條件達成後才可交割。待台灣大取得精誠過半股權，未來除可用權益法認列獲利，若經董事會改選，也能夠合併報表，希望最快今年就可以發生。
因此林之晨表示，短期首要任務就是在股權過半後，進行董事會改選，但他強調，改選後還是希望維持現在經營團隊的穩定。同時，雙方團隊將進行深度策略聯盟，包括業務與商品資訊的交換，讓綜效極大化。
針對日本與東南亞市場，林之晨指出，精誠在新加坡成立SYSTEX Asia東南亞營運總部，在日本也與伊藤忠商事合作，待收購完成，將進一步與精誠共同在東南亞與日本市場推進AI相關業務布局。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held a major press conference today (the 12th) announcing that it will publicly acquire ordinary shares of Systex Information (6214‑TW) through its wholly‑owned subsidiary Taiwan Telecom. The goal is to increase its holding by at least 39% to a majority stake, with the total purchase price capped at NT$29.13 billion. General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company is highly confident about the synergies from the deal and, once it holds more than half the shares, it could significantly boost both parties’ revenue and profit as early as this year.

Lin said the public acquisition of Systex aims to forge a deep ICT alliance in the AI era, integrating information‑technology (IT) and telecommunications (CT) to create three major synergies – cross‑selling, AI, and regionalization. The target is to double Systex’s market share in the IT services sector from 7% to 14%, which would help Taiwan Mobile’s revenue reach the NT$1 trillion level in four to five years.

Lin explained that the consideration for the public purchase will be half cash and half share‑swap: for each Systex ordinary share sold, the seller will receive 0.84 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares plus NT$92.5 in cash.

Based on today’s closing prices of Taiwan Mobile and Systex, the implied per‑share purchase price is about NT$184.5, a premium of roughly 29.5%. Using the average closing price over the past quarter the premium is about 32.5%, and using the average over the past six months the premium is about 38.5%.

Taiwan Mobile clarified that it aims to acquire at least 39% and up to 58% of Systex, with the total purchase price ranging from NT$19.58 billion to NT$29.13 billion. The consideration includes Taiwan Telecom holding between 89,186,829 and 132,636,822 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares (about 2.4%–3.6% of Taiwan Mobile’s equity) and a cash component of NT$9.821 billion to NT$14.606 billion, to be funded with internal cash and loans from related parties within the Taiwan Mobile group.

Lin said the public acquisition is slated to start on August 18 and is expected to be completed within 50 days, subject to filing with and approval by the Fair Trade Commission. The transaction will only close once the 39% share threshold is met and two other conditions are satisfied. After Taiwan Mobile obtains a majority stake in Systex, it can recognize profits under the equity method and, if the board is re‑elected, consolidate Systex’s financial statements, potentially as early as this year.

Therefore, Lin stated that the short‑term priority after crossing the 50% ownership line is to hold a board election, while emphasizing that the existing management team will remain stable after the election. Both companies will also deepen their strategic alliance, including the exchange of business and product information, to maximize synergies.

Regarding Japan and Southeast Asia, Lin noted that Systex has established a Southeast Asia operations headquarters, SYSTEX Asia, in Singapore and has a partnership with Itochu Corp. in Japan. Once the acquisition is completed, the two firms will jointly advance AI‑related business initiatives in Southeast Asian and Japanese markets.

items.title_en: Qihong Earnings Call AI Summary 2026/8/12
paras:
一、奇鋐(3017-TW)2026年第二季財務與營運詳情 



獲利能力顯著提升：第二季毛利率32.57%，較第一季提升2.8個百分點，較去年同期增加8.16個百分點；營業利益率27.44%；單季EPS 24.37元，年增136.6%。營收成長正有效轉化為更高的獲利品質，重心已從規模擴張轉向獲利品質。
營收與產品組合持續優化：上半年營收981億元，年增85.5%。Thermol與Chassis產品合計佔比83.42%，成長主動能來自伺服器應用：上半年伺服器營收年增153.4%，佔比由48.4%升至66.1%，是優化產品組合與提升毛利率的關鍵。
財務狀況穩健，現金流強勁：截至6月底，現金777億元，股東權益551.97億元；負債比降至68.07%。雖受供應鏈影響存貨週轉天數增至145天，但流動性充足。上半年營業活動現金流入262億元，年增175%；自由現金流191.979億元，近三倍成長，顯示營運現金流強勁。

【奇鋐法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】 

Q1：今年下半年的營收與毛利展望為何？ 

回答：公司維持先前的展望，下半年產品陸續進入量產階段，整體營收與獲利預計逐季走高，下半年表現將優於上半年(實際狀況仍需視客戶拉貨時程與供應鏈狀況而定)。此外，公司持續引進自動化設備生產，對整體毛利率有顯著幫助，管理層對未來保持樂觀。

Q2：公司對於水冷(Liquid Cooling)業務的營收比重如何拆分？ 

回答：公司不對外拆分水冷業務的單一營收比重。主因是水冷專案包含 Cooling、Manifold、Quick Disconnect (QD) 等多項組件，部分專案更涵蓋機構件與風扇。公司定位為「全方位熱能與機構解決方案提供者(Total Thermal and Mechanical Solution Provider)」，內部管理以專案與客戶維度為主，不以氣冷/水冷劃分。但可確定的是，AI Server 對營收的貢獻比重持續上升。

Q3：NVIDIA GB200(或 B200)水冷產品的出貨進度與新廠貢獻時程？ 

回答：完全依照客戶給予的專案排程推進。目前新廠針對相關產品已開始進入量產階段，預計於第三季(Q3)開始產生營收貢獻。

Q4：針對 Google、Amazon 等大型 CSP 客戶的 ASIC/TPU 專案，供貨情況與滲透率為何？ 

回答：公司不評論單一客戶細節，但強調在核心 ASIC 客戶群中皆維持主導的供應商地位。水冷滲透率正顯著提高，許多客戶的第一代、第二代 ASIC 專案已開始放量生產，公司均為主要供應商，並持續提供設計、驗證到量產的一站式服務。

Q5：ASIC 與 GPU 散熱產品的發展方向為何？2027 年 ASIC 比重是否會超越 GPU？ 

回答：公司並未針對 ASIC 與 GPU 做細項比例統計，且對公司而言兩者並非二選一。無論是 ASIC 還是 GPU 平臺，對於散熱功耗與機櫃密度的需求都在大幅提升，因此兩大平臺都會持續出貨並共同受益。

Q6：雙相浸沒式水冷(Two-phase Cooling)的開發進度與市場接受度如何？ 

回答：公司擁有專業研發團隊且技術成熟，雙相水冷的散熱表現確實優於單相水冷。然而，評估目前晶片 TDP 與系統可靠度後，客戶現階段權衡下仍以「單相直接水冷(Single-phase Cold Plate)」為最適方案。散熱技術會隨需求漸進式演進，不會出現一夕之間的斷崖式技術更替。

Q7：若未來晶片功耗(TDP)達到 3000W 到 5000W 以上，散熱方案如何因應？ 

回答：公司現階段已可提供 3000W 以上的散熱解決方案，技術上並無物理天花板。未來的解法包含：強化單相水冷、優化機櫃架構、調校流量、採用裸晶封裝或金屬套件(Metal Kit)等，會依據客戶系統層級的限制提供客製化組合。

Q8：機殼與機櫃(Server Chassis/Rack)事業的展望與毛利變化？ 

回答：隨著機櫃密度提升，機殼需要承載 Manifold、風扇、水冷組件等，結構強度、氣流設計與可維修性難度大增，帶動單櫃價值量與設計門檻顯著提升。雖然不針對單一產品評論毛利率，但整體發展趨勢會越來越好，機殼/機構件將隨水冷產品一同強勁成長。

Q9：今年的資本支出(Capex)規劃與籌資計畫？ 

回答：今年的 Capital Expenditure (Capex) 預計約為新臺幣 150 億元，明年的 Capex 會比今年更多(產能擴充以越南廠區為主)。目前營運現金流與銀行額度相當充裕，足以支應現有擴產計畫，暫無其他籌資計畫。

Q10：面對市場對 CSP 客戶 Capex 投資回報的疑慮，公司對 AI 長期趨勢的看法？ 

回答：公司堅信 AI 趨勢是真實且持續發展的。整體產業在技術、資源與資本上的投入不斷增加，水冷在資料中心(Data Center)的滲透率今年確定會持續提升(預計滲透率將超過 50%)。

paras_en: 1. Qihong (3017-TW) detailed Q2 2026 financial and operational results. Profitability improved markedly: Q2 gross margin 32.57%, up 2.8 percentage points from Q1 and 8.16 points year‑over‑year; operating margin 27.44%; quarterly EPS NT$24.37, up 136.6% YoY. Revenue growth is translating into higher profit quality, shifting focus from scale expansion to profit quality.

2. Revenue and product mix continue to be optimized: H1 revenue NT$98.1 billion, up 85.5% YoY. Thermol and Chassis products together accounted for 83.42% of sales, with growth driven by server applications: H1 server revenue rose 153.4% YoY, increasing its share from 48.4% to 66.1%, a key factor in product‑mix optimization and margin improvement.

3. Financial position remains solid and cash flow strong: as of end‑June cash stood at NT$77.7 billion, shareholders’ equity NT$55.197 billion; debt ratio fell to 68.07%. Although supply‑chain issues pushed inventory turnover to 145 days, liquidity is ample. H1 operating cash inflow was NT$26.2 billion, up 175% YoY; free cash flow NT$19.1979 billion, nearly three‑fold growth, indicating robust operating cash generation.

4. Complete Q&A list from Qihong earnings call. Q1: What are the revenue and margin outlook for the second half of the year? Answer: The company maintains its prior outlook; products will enter mass production sequentially, and overall revenue and profit are expected to rise quarter over quarter, with H2 performance projected to exceed H1 (actual results will depend on customer pull‑in timing and supply‑chain conditions). Ongoing automation investments are expected to significantly boost gross margin, and management remains optimistic about the future.

5. Q2: How is the revenue contribution of the liquid‑cooling business broken down? Answer: The company does not disclose a single revenue share for liquid‑cooling because projects include cooling modules, manifolds, quick disconnects and often mechanical parts and fans. Qihong positions itself as a total thermal and mechanical solution provider, managing projects by customer and project rather than by air‑ vs. liquid‑cooling. However, the contribution of AI servers to revenue is clearly increasing.

6. Q3: What is the shipment progress of NVIDIA GB200 (or B200) liquid‑cooling products and the timeline for contribution from the new plant? Answer: Progress follows the customer‑provided project schedule. The new plant has already begun mass production for the relevant products and is expected to start generating revenue in Q3.

7. Q4: Regarding ASIC/TPU projects for large CSP customers such as Google and Amazon, what is the supply situation and penetration rate? Answer: The company does not comment on individual customer details but emphasizes that it remains a leading supplier for core ASIC customers. Liquid‑cooling penetration is rising sharply; first‑ and second‑generation ASIC projects for many customers are now in volume production, with Qihong serving as a primary supplier and offering end‑to‑end services from design and verification to mass production.

8. Q5: What are the development directions for ASIC and GPU cooling products? Will ASIC’s share surpass GPU’s by 2027? Answer: The company does not maintain detailed ratio statistics for ASIC versus GPU, and it does not view the two as mutually exclusive. Both platforms are driving higher cooling power and cabinet density demands, so both will continue to ship and benefit together.

9. Q6: What is the development status and market acceptance of two‑phase immersion cooling? Answer: Qihong has a professional R&D team and mature technology; two‑phase cooling indeed outperforms single‑phase cooling in heat‑removal. However, after evaluating current chip TDPs and system reliability, customers presently favor single‑phase cold‑plate solutions as the optimal choice. Cooling technologies will evolve incrementally with demand, without abrupt, cliff‑like transitions.

10. Q7: If future chip TDPs reach 3,000 W to 5,000 W or higher, how will cooling solutions adapt? Answer: Qihong already offers solutions above 3,000 W and sees no physical ceiling. Future approaches include strengthening single‑phase water cooling, optimizing rack architecture, adjusting flow rates, and employing bare‑die packaging or metal kits, with customized combos based on each customer’s system constraints.

11. Q8: What is the outlook for the server chassis/rack business and its margin trends? Answer: As rack density increases, chassis must accommodate manifolds, fans, and liquid‑cooling components, raising structural strength, airflow design, and serviceability challenges, which lifts per‑rack value and design thresholds. While the company does not comment on margins for individual products, the overall trend is positive, and chassis/mechanical parts are expected to grow strongly alongside liquid‑cooling offerings.

12. Q9: What are this year’s capital expenditure plans and financing strategy? Answer: Capital expenditure for the year is projected at roughly NT$15 billion, with next year’s Capex expected to be higher, focusing on capacity expansion mainly at the Vietnam facility. Current operating cash flow and bank credit are ample to fund existing expansion plans, and no additional financing is planned at this time.

13. Q10: Facing market concerns about CSP customers’ Capex ROI, what is the company’s view on the long‑term AI trend? Answer: The company firmly believes the AI trend is real and ongoing. Industry investment in technology, resources, and capital continues to rise, and liquid‑cooling penetration in data centers is expected to exceed 50% this year.

items.title_en: Evergreen Chemical Reports Narrower Loss in First Half, Eyes Diversification Strategy
paras: PU合成廠永捷(4714-TW)公告今(2026)年上半年自結財報，稅後淨損1,774 萬元、每股稅後淨損0.1元，整體營運表現較去(2025)年同期虧損大幅收斂。永捷表示，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，嚴控成本費用，加上業外表現挹注業績表現，下半年將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU與高科技電子產業之全方位應用。
永捷今年上半年合併營收達11.85 億元、年增76.15％；稅後淨損1,774 萬元，整體營運表現較去年同期虧損大幅收斂，營業毛利為1.73 億元、年增28.76％，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，並嚴控成本費用。

永捷今年7月營收達1.5億元、月增5.65％、年增14.66％；累計2026年1-7 月合併營收達13.34 億元、年增66.13％，7月單月與前7月累計營收雙雙刷新歷年同期新高，成長主因在於公司積極布局高附加價值之環保型PU樹脂與水性PU材料，隨著運動鞋材、機能服飾及傳統皮革等終端市場需求回溫，客戶拉貨力道強勁，帶動產能利用率顯著提升。同時，永捷旗下「荷久暻」建案如期完工交屋並認列房產銷售收入，雙引擎齊發助也推升營收繳出亮眼成績單。
展望2026 年下半年，永捷維持審慎樂觀態度。公司將持續以「綠色環保」與「高附加價值」為核心，發揮台灣廠作為全球研發與運籌中心之優勢，並積極開展海外策略聯盟。
面對國際地緣政治與通膨壓力等全球總體經濟挑戰，永捷表示，將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU 市場與高科技電子產業之全方位應用，在產銷政策上，重點布局高固成分與無溶劑濕氣反應型PUR、TPU 產品，油/水性家具革與汽車革，以及快乾型架橋劑與成衣環保水性產品。
paras_en: Evergreen Chemical (4714-TW) announced its unaudited consolidated financial report for the first half of 2026, with a net loss of NT$17.74 million and a net loss per share of NT$0.1. The company's overall performance improved significantly compared to the same period last year.

Evergreen Chemical's consolidated revenue for the first half of 2026 reached NT$1.185 billion, a year-on-year increase of 76.15%. The company's net loss was NT$17.74 million, with a significant improvement in overall performance compared to the same period last year. Gross profit was NT$173 million, a year-on-year increase of 28.76%.

Evergreen Chemical's revenue in July reached NT$150 million, a month-on-month increase of 5.65% and a year-on-year increase of 14.66%. The company's cumulative revenue for January-July 2026 reached NT$1.334 billion, a year-on-year increase of 66.13%. Both the July single-month and cumulative revenue for the first seven months broke new highs, driven by the company's active layout of high-value-added environmentally friendly PU resins and water-based PU materials.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Evergreen Chemical maintains a cautious optimism. The company will continue to focus on 'green and environmentally friendly' and 'high-value-added' products, leveraging its Taiwan-based manufacturing as a global R&D and logistics center, and actively developing overseas strategic partnerships.

In the face of global economic challenges such as international geopolitics and inflationary pressures, Evergreen Chemical will adopt a 'vertical integration and diversification' strategy, deepening its application of traditional PU markets and high-tech electronics industries. The company will focus on developing high-solid content and solvent-free wet reaction type PUR, TPU products, oil/water-based furniture leather and automotive leather, as well as fast-drying type bridging agents and environmentally friendly water-based clothing products.
