paras: 屬台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的設備廠迅得 (6438-TW) 今(12)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年上半年稅後純益3.11億元，年增19.07%，每股純益達3.79元，公司擬對上半年股利配息3元，並擬發行5億元無擔保可轉換公司債進行市場籌資。
迅得2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，稅後純益1.66億元，單季獲利也超越首季的 1.45 億元，每股純益2.03元。2026年1-6月營收35.68億元，毛利率26.13%，稅後純益3.11億元，每股純益3.79元。而迅得公布最新營收資訊，迅得2026 年 7 月營收以 6.38 億元改寫歷年同期新高。
迅得營運總部也在遷入的新生廠，產能已進人滿載，將推升 2026 年獲利成長幅度攀高。迅得機械在 2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，法人估計迅得 2026 年第三季單月平均營收在 6 億元之上 ，有機會再創新高，第四季由於安排出貨的半導體設備出貨逐步步入高峰，預估下半年營運勝過 上半年，全年營收將再較 2025 年的 64.67 億元再增 10-15%，再創新高。
迅得擁有在半導體及 PCB 設備需求雙重成長動能，同時，迅得在 PCB 設備指向高階產品廠商的需求，也與臻鼎 - KY(4958-TW) 及景碩 (3189-TW) 有大單確立，其中臻鼎 - KY 下單 10.2 億元，而景碩也在 7 億元之上。。
迅得 2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，2026 下半年預估在出貨產品組合的有利因素加持下超過上半年表現 ，全年營收估成長 10-15%，而在獲利成長幅度可望以優於營收成長幅度倍數成長呈現。
同時，迅得半導體相關設備出貨上將在第四季起出現明顯成長，半導體設備營收在 2027 年也將維持此一營運旺盛態勢。
迅得在今年第一季營收爲 17.45 億元，稅後純益 1.45 億元，每股純益 1.76 元，第二季營收 18.24 億元，在出貨產品組合、匯率有利及收回逾期帳款挹注之下，迅得 2026 年第二季營收、獲利較首季增加。
在迅得產能規劃方面，迅得新建中壢新生廠的廠房高達 1.2 萬坪，公司營運總部也遷入新生廠；迅得中壢新生廠設有無塵室並主攻半導體設備生產，迅得董事長王年清指出，目前中壢新生廠產能並已經滿載，迅得正設法取得取得其他營運及倉儲空間以確保備妥下半年營運增溫的需求。
paras_en: XunDe (6438‑TW), a equipment supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain, announced on the 12th its latest profit figures: H1 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$311 million, up 19.07% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$3.79. The company intends to pay a NT$3 dividend for the first half and plans to issue NT$5 billion of unsecured convertible bonds to raise capital in the market.

In Q2 2026 XunDe recorded revenue of NT$1.824 billion, a new high, with after‑tax net profit of NT$166 million. The quarterly profit also surpassed Q1’s NT$145 million, delivering EPS of NT$2.03. For the January‑June period, revenue reached NT$3.568 billion, gross margin was 26.13%, after‑tax net profit was NT$311 million and EPS was NT$3.79. The company also reported that July 2026 revenue of NT$638 million set a new historical high for the month.

July 2026 revenue was NT$638 million, up 7.61% month‑over‑month and 5.38% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July 2026 amounted to NT$4.207 billion, an increase of 10.97% from the prior year.

XunDe’s operations headquarters has moved into the new Xinsheng plant, where capacity is already fully loaded, which is expected to lift profit growth in 2026. The machinery segment posted a record Q2 revenue of NT$1.824 billion; analysts estimate that average monthly revenue in Q3 2026 will exceed NT$600 million, potentially setting another record. In Q4, shipments of semiconductor equipment are expected to peak, and the second half is forecasted to outperform the first half. Full‑year revenue is projected to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, reaching a new high.

XunDe enjoys dual growth momentum from semiconductor and PCB equipment demand. In the PCB segment, targeting high‑end product makers, it has secured large orders from Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW). Zhen Ding‑KY placed an order worth NT$1.02 billion, while Jing Shuo’s order exceeds NT$700 million.

H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% year‑over‑year. The company expects H2 revenue to surpass H1 performance thanks to favorable product‑mix factors, projecting full‑year revenue growth of 10‑15%. Profit growth is anticipated to outpace revenue growth by a multiple.
Semiconductor‑related equipment shipments are expected to show a clear increase starting in Q4, and semiconductor equipment revenue is expected to remain robust throughout 2027.

In Q1 2026, XunDe generated revenue of NT$1.745 billion, after‑tax net profit of NT$145 million and EPS of NT$1.76. In Q2, revenue rose to NT$1.824 billion, driven by a favorable product mix, advantageous exchange‑rate effects and the recovery of overdue receivables, resulting in higher revenue and profit compared with Q1.

Regarding capacity planning, XunDe’s newly built Zhongli Xinsheng plant spans 12,000 ping, and the company’s operations headquarters has relocated there. The plant features a cleanroom and focuses on semiconductor equipment production. Chairman Wang Nianqing noted that the Xinsheng plant’s capacity is already fully utilized, and the company is seeking additional operational and warehousing space to ensure it can meet the increased demand anticipated in the second half of the year.

items.title: 〈聯亞法說〉CW Laser產能供不應求 基板缺料問題不大
items.title_en: Lianya's Law: CW Laser production in short supply, substrate shortage not significant
paras: 聯亞 (3081-TW) 今 (12) 日下午舉行法說會，並自結公告今 ( 2026) 年第 2 季、上半年財報及說明未來布局展望，聯亞因受惠矽光產品需求強勁、出貨持續放大挹注下，第 2 季除了獲利創單新高，在矽光產品上，隨AI資料中心帶動需求，目前產能狀況已相當吃緊，產品中Datacom中CW Laser占比最大，也陸續擴大資本支出及代工因應。
聯亞第 2 季財報繳出三率三升，連續 2 季繳出佳績。隨著資料中心需求持續增加，聯亞表示，矽光需求依然非常強勁，隨著公司與下游代工廠的產能持續攀升，預期矽光產品出貨量在未來幾個季度還會持續增加。
聯亞指出，目前CW Laser產能狀況已相當吃緊，代工廠產能遠遠不足公司需求，也證實的確有些訂單委由外面代工廠代工，同時在AI資料中心持續建置下，CW Laser在光通訊後續發展上具有很大優勢，這也是目前聯亞仍持續擴大資本支出的原因，公司主要產能上還是放在CW Laser上。
此外，針對原料磷化銦(InP)全球持續缺料影響，聯亞也表示，雖受中國管制，但聯亞已與其他供應商有持續接觸，目前基板缺料問題不大。
聯亞強調，未來資料中心在AI應用上從過去scale-out，接下來將會導入光通訊，逐步延伸至EML及接收端光電二極體(PD)等，EML與CW Laser各有應用優勢，並非相互取代或互斥，不同的光通訊傳輸也互有優勢。
paras_en: Lianya (3081-TW) held a law meeting today (12) and announced its second quarter and first half of 2026 financial report, as well as its future layout outlook. Lianya benefited from the strong demand for silicon light products, with continuous shipments increasing, and its second quarter profit reached a new high. In addition, due to the strong demand for silicon light products driven by AI data centers, the current production capacity is already quite tight. The company has also expanded its capital expenditures and outsourcing to cope with the situation.

Lianya's second quarter financial report achieved a three-rate three-rise, with two consecutive quarters of good performance. As the demand for data centers continues to increase, Lianya stated that the demand for silicon light products remains extremely strong, and with the company's production capacity and downstream outsourcing factories continuing to rise, it is expected that silicon light product shipments will continue to increase in the next few quarters.

Lianya pointed out that the current CW Laser production capacity is already quite tight, and the outsourcing factory's production capacity is far from meeting the company's demand. It has been confirmed that some orders have been outsourced to external factories. Meanwhile, with the continuous construction of AI data centers, CW Laser has a significant advantage in the development of optical communication, which is also the reason why Lianya is still expanding its capital expenditures. The company's main production capacity is still focused on CW Laser.

In addition, Lianya also stated that, despite the global shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrate, which is subject to Chinese regulations, Lianya has been in continuous contact with other suppliers, and the substrate shortage is not significant.

Lianya emphasized that in the future, data centers will transition from scale-out to optical communication, and will gradually extend to EML and receive end optical photodiodes (PD). EML and CW Laser have different application advantages and are not mutually exclusive or mutually exclusive. Different optical communication transmission also has its own advantages.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉溫和CPI消除升息疑慮 費半強漲近2.5% 記憶體類股噴高
paras: 美國7月通膨略為降溫，強化聯準會9月維持利率不變的預期，加上AI基礎設施及記憶體類股強勢上漲，美股週三 (12 日) 多收高。費半指數勁揚近 2.5%，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，標普500指數漲0.26%，道瓊指數幾乎收在平盤。
美國7月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增3.4%，符合市場預期，低於6月的3.5%；月增率則為0.1%。通膨持續降溫後，交易員轉而押注聯準會9月將按兵不動，扭轉前一日升息與維持利率不變機率約各半的局面。
不過，美國通膨率仍高於聯準會2%目標，加上中東局勢持續推高能源價格及美債殖利率，使聯準會官員對是否升息仍存在分歧。
美國與伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽的談判持續陷入僵局。美方週二對一艘試圖穿越阿曼灣、懸掛巴拿馬國旗的船隻開火，進一步加劇市場對原油供應的擔憂，布蘭特原油期貨一度逼近每桶90美元。
油價上漲也推高美國汽油價格。全美普通汽油平均價格週三升至每加侖4.03美元，較一個月前上漲約0.16美元，創歷年8月中旬同期新高。
美股週三 (12 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭盡墨。Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.38%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.87%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 微跌 0.08%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.83%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.82%；博通 (AVGO-US) 微跌 0.01%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.03%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 大漲 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.24%。
記憶體與儲存類股同步走高。美光科技 (MU-US) 大漲 4.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 3.69%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 勁揚 5.76%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 大漲 7.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.01%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.68%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.63%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.95%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
溫蒂漢堡 (WEN-US) 瘋漲14.70%至每股 8.66 美元，英國《金融時報》引述消息人士報導，億萬富豪投資人Nelson Peltz 旗下 Trian Fund Management 正準備提出收購要約，計劃將溫蒂漢堡私有化。
全球AI伺服器大廠美超微 (SMCI-US) 暴漲19.02%至每股 37.61 美元，其第四季業績優於預期，同時發布樂觀的第一季財測，顯示 AI 伺服器需求仍然穩健。
AI 雲端運算公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 猛升 19.28% 至每股 107.73 美元，公司第二季調整後營業利益率達 5%，優於市場預期，營收較去年同期成長逾一倍。
Nebius Group (NBIS-US) 週三漲幅高逾34% 至每股 259.20 美元。這家 AI 基礎設施公司公布的稅前息前折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 與營收均優於 FactSet 調查的分析師預期，毛利率表現也超出市場預估。
Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) 大幅走高13.63%至每股 932.47 美元，該公司調整後每股盈餘及營收雙雙優於市場預期。受惠於 AI 熱潮，Lumentum股價今年迄今已上漲超過一倍。
華爾街分析
CPI 公布後，市場對聯準會 9 月按兵不動的預期升溫。
摩根士丹利財富管理首席經濟策略師 Ellen Zentner 表示，符合預期的通膨數據，將延續上週就業報告公布後形成的「沒有升息必要」論述。9 月聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議前仍有一輪通膨數據，但除非數字呈現截然不同的走勢，聯準會下月仍可能維持利率不變。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)

items.title: 中國C919首度跨出國門！為何仍難擺脫波音與空中巴士？
items.title_en: China's C919 Makes First International Commercial Flight, But Challenges Remain
paras: 中國自主研發的C919客機周三(12日)執行首次定期國際商業航班，從北京飛往蒙古烏蘭巴托，象徵中國試圖在波音(BA-US)與空中巴士主導的全球民航市場建立第三種選擇。不過，C919仍高度依賴外國零組件，尚未取得美國及歐洲主要航空監管機構的適航認證，加上產能與售後支援體系仍待提升，短期內撼動兩大巨頭的難度不小。
這架由中國國際航空營運的C919，於當地時間周三下午3時過後從北京首都國際機場起飛，約兩小時後抵達烏蘭巴托。根據中國國航規劃，北京至烏蘭巴托航線未來將每日飛航，這也是C919首度以定期商業航班形式飛出中國領土。
C919由中國國營飛機製造商中國商飛(COMAC)研發，是最多可搭載174名乘客的單走道窄體客機，鎖定與波音737 MAX及空中巴士A320neo相同的市場。此次首航是中國推動國產大型客機走向國際市場的重要里程碑，也延續中國商飛近年積極在海外展示產品的布局。

產能距目標仍遠 關鍵零組件依賴外國供應

儘管C919被視為中國航空工業的重要突破，但其供應鏈仍高度仰賴海外廠商。墨卡托中國研究中心(MERICS)分析師Andreas Mischer指出，C919生產所需的許多關鍵零組件依舊來自外國供應商，其中發動機由美國奇異航太(GE Aerospace)與法國賽峰飛機發動機(Safran Aircraft Engines)合資成立的CFM International製造。
C919也尚未取得美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)或歐洲航空安全總署(EASA)認證，限制中國商飛爭取歐美及其他採認相關標準的海外航空公司訂單。Mischer並指出，中國商飛未能達成「中國製造2025」設定的目標，也就是讓國產大型客機取得中國國內市場10%的市占率。
中國商飛近年持續提升C919的國際曝光度。C919與較小型的C909於2025年11月首度參加杜拜航空展，公司當時表示，希望進一步深化與全球航空產業的關係。
中國是全球最大航空市場之一，為中國商飛提供龐大的本土客戶基礎，但中國航空公司仍離不開波音與空中巴士。今年5月，中國確認訂購200架波音飛機，以及相關發動機與零組件，顯示北京即使大力扶植國產客機，仍須依賴美國製造的商用飛機。
C919目前已累積可觀的積壓訂單，但主要客戶仍是中國航空公司與租賃業者，實際產量也相對有限。截至2025年底，中國商飛累計僅交付32架C919，相較之下，空中巴士光是在2025年就向中國交付約100架窄體客機。今年上半年，中國商飛另交付8架C919，距離2029年達到年產200架的目標仍相當遙遠。

不只要造得出來 售後支援才是競爭關鍵

已退休的航空業分析師Rob Morris表示，中國商飛的研發與生產速度過於緩慢，目前還不足以真正與波音及空中巴士競爭。C919雖有潛力影響兩大巨頭在中國市場的銷售，但執行進度意味著這項衝擊仍須一段時間才會浮現，關鍵在於航空公司與乘客能否接受這款飛機。
Morris指出，飛機製造商不能只負責研發、生產與交付，還必須建立全年無休的服務體系，確保C919的航班派遣可靠度能與市場熟悉且已長期驗證的A320及737相當。這種能力只能透過長時間、持續營運逐步證明。
航空顧問公司AeroDynamic Advisory董事總經理Richard Aboulafia則強調，製造飛機需要所有零件到位，即使短缺的只是扣件，也可能使整架飛機無法完成交付。飛機供應鏈層級繁多，從發動機、機身組件到鑄件、鍛件與扣件，任何環節都可能形成瓶頸。
Mischer認為，中國商飛若要具備全球競爭力，必須先穩固供應鏈、大幅提升產能並建立規模經濟；即使做到這些，要讓結構如此複雜的民航客機完全自主化仍十分困難。
儘管挑戰重重，C919仍是中國航太產業的重要成就。能夠整合龐大零組件、系統及軟體並打造可投入商業營運的客機，本身就是目前全球僅波音、空中巴士等少數業者掌握的能力。此次飛往烏蘭巴托，證明C919跨出了國際化的第一步，但距離真正打破全球民航雙雄格局仍有很長的路。
paras_en: China's domestically developed C919 aircraft made its first international commercial flight on Wednesday, flying from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. This marks China's attempt to establish a third option in the global commercial aviation market dominated by Boeing (BA-US) and Airbus. However, the C919 still relies heavily on foreign components, has not obtained certification from major aviation regulatory bodies in the US and Europe, and its production capacity and after-sales support system need to be improved, making it difficult to challenge the two giants in the short term.

The C919, operated by China International Airlines, took off from Beijing Capital International Airport at 3 pm local time on Wednesday and arrived in Ulaanbaatar about two hours later. According to China National Aviation Corporation's plans, the Beijing-Ulaanbaatar route will operate daily in the future, marking the C919's first regular commercial flight outside China.

The C919 is developed by China's state-owned aircraft manufacturer, COMAC (China Commercial Aircraft Corporation), and can carry up to 174 passengers. It targets the same market as Boeing's 737 MAX and Airbus's A320neo. This flight is an important milestone for China's push to promote domestic large aircraft on the international market, and it continues China Commercial Aircraft's efforts to showcase its products overseas in recent years.

Despite being considered a major breakthrough for China's aviation industry, the C919's supply chain still relies heavily on foreign suppliers. Andreas Mischer, an analyst at the MERICS (Mercator Institute for China Studies) in Germany, pointed out that many critical components needed for the C919's production still come from foreign suppliers, including the engine, which is manufactured by CFM International, a joint venture between GE Aerospace (USA) and Safran Aircraft Engines (France).

The C919 has not yet obtained certification from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) or the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), limiting China Commercial Aircraft's ability to secure orders from overseas airlines that adopt similar standards. Mischer also noted that China Commercial Aircraft has not yet achieved its goal of 'Made in China 2025,' which aims to have domestic large aircraft account for 10% of the Chinese market.

China Commercial Aircraft has been increasing the international exposure of the C919 in recent years. The C919 and its smaller cousin, the C909, made their debut at the Dubai Airshow in November 2025, with the company expressing its desire to further deepen its relationships with the global aviation industry.

China is one of the world's largest aviation markets, providing a massive domestic customer base for China Commercial Aircraft. However, Chinese airlines still rely heavily on Boeing and Airbus. In May this year, China confirmed an order for 200 Boeing aircraft, including engines and components, indicating that Beijing still needs to rely on US-made commercial aircraft despite its efforts to promote domestic aircraft.

The C919 has accumulated a significant backlog of orders, but its main customers are still Chinese airlines and leasing companies. The actual production volume is relatively limited. As of the end of 2025, China Commercial Aircraft had delivered only 32 C919s, compared to Airbus's delivery of around 100 narrow-body aircraft to China in 2025 alone. In the first half of this year, China Commercial Aircraft delivered another 8 C919s, leaving a long way to go to reach its target of producing 200 C919s per year by 2029.
It's not just about producing it; after-sales support is the key to competition

Retired aviation analyst Rob Morris pointed out that China Commercial Aircraft's research and development and production pace are too slow, and it is still not competitive with Boeing and Airbus. Although the C919 has the potential to impact the sales of the two giants in the Chinese market, the execution pace means that this impact will take time to emerge, and the key is whether airlines and passengers can accept this aircraft.

Morris noted that aircraft manufacturers cannot just be responsible for research and development, production, and delivery; they must also establish a year-round service system to ensure the reliability of C919 flight deployments, which should be comparable to the A320 and 737, which have been well-established and verified in the market. This ability can only be proven through long-term and continuous operation.

AeroDynamic Advisory's director general, Richard Aboulafia, emphasized that manufacturing aircraft requires all components to be in place, even if it's just a missing screw, which could prevent the entire aircraft from being delivered. The aircraft supply chain is complex, with multiple levels, from engines, fuselage components to forgings, stampings, and fasteners, and any link can form a bottleneck.

Mischer believes that China Commercial Aircraft must first stabilize its supply chain, significantly increase production capacity, and establish a scale economy to become a global competitor. Even if it achieves these goals, it will still be difficult to completely self-sustain such a complex commercial aircraft.

items.title: 美股大漲引爆退休潮！美銀：「財富效應」讓55歲以上勞工安心退職
items.title_en: US Stocks Surge Sparks Retirement Wave! Bank of America: “Wealth Effect” Lets Workers Over 55 Retire Comfortably
paras: 美銀證券(Bank of America Securities)最新報告指出，美國大量年長勞工正逐步退出勞動力市場，這可能和股市大漲帶來的財富效應有關。
55歲以上勞工的勞動參與率在疫情衝擊後始終未能完全恢復，近期更進一步下滑。2020年2月、也就是疫情正式宣告前夕，美國55歲以上勞工的勞動參與率為40.3%，到了2026年7月，進一步降至36.9%。
美銀證券美國經濟學家Aditya Bhave說：「我們認為，這與過去兩年標普500指數上漲超過35%有關。」這波漲勢可能讓許多原本正在考慮何時退休的人，更容易做出退出職場的決定。
Bhave說：「勞動市場數據一直存在一個謎題。如果縱觀美國經濟，大多數指標在疫情後都恢復得非常好，速度也遠快於我們原本預期。其中一個落後的就是年長勞工的勞動參與率。而過去幾個月，這項指標又進一步下滑。」
不過，Bhave也謹慎表示，不能把年長勞工退出職場完全歸因於股市上漲。
他說：「我不認為有任何單一因素可以完全解釋這個現象。但考量到過去幾年股市的表現，以及自2020年以來的累計漲幅——標普500指數如今已經翻了超過一倍——這種財富增加很可能會讓部分民眾更有誘因退休，因為他們會覺得：『好，我不用工作了。』」
Bhave補充：「這讓人們對退休有相當程度的信心。即使是風險承受度相對較低的人，也擁有相當大的緩衝空間。」

如果股市反轉 他們的財富會怎麼樣？

對此，Bhave表示，即使股市出現回檔，部分退休族可能仍有足夠的財富緩衝。「就這個情況而言，我認為他們擁有足夠的緩衝，因此可能會認為：股市可能出現回檔，但只要不是災難性的崩跌，考量到過去財富已大幅累積，即使股市下跌，我仍然放心退休。」
為接近退休年齡客戶提供服務的理財顧問，對這項分析並不感到意外。《Women and Wealth》一書作者、認證理財規劃師Cary Carbonaro表示，財富效應確實存在。
她說：「我們經歷了2023年、2024年和2025年的兩位數股市漲幅，2026年目前也有望延續這樣的表現。退休潮正在因這些漲幅而發生，這讓我的客戶擁有過去沒有的更多選擇。」
位於堪薩斯州Overland Park的理財規劃師Tyson Sprick也有類似觀察，「螢幕上的數字從來沒有這麼漂亮過，部分客戶因此獲得信心，終於決定退休。」
不過，他也表示，客戶同時會問：「這種情況還能持續多久？」以及「如果股市大跌，我還能安然無恙嗎？」
「因此，我們會把所有這些因素納入考量，根據目前的市場水準採用前瞻性的財務規劃假設。雖然我們無法預測未來，但我們並沒有忽視這項事實：這種強勁報酬不可能永遠持續。」
即使尚未準備退休的民眾，也正受惠於這波市場榮景。根據美銀另一份數據，2026年第2季，401(k)平均帳戶餘額已達12萬4250美元，較一年前增加15%。數據顯示，約三分之二的員工認為，目前的退休儲蓄進度足以讓他們在理想的退休年齡、而且以自己期望的生活方式退休，這個比率較去年增加6個百分點。
paras_en: Bank of America Securities’ latest report says a large number of older U.S. workers are gradually exiting the labor market, possibly linked to the wealth effect from the big stock rally.

The labor‑force participation rate of workers aged 55 and over has never fully recovered after the pandemic shock and has recently slipped further. In February 2020, just before the pandemic was declared, the participation rate was 40.3%; by July 2026 it had fallen to 36.9%.

Bank of America economist Aditya Bhave said, “We think this is related to the S&P 500’s rise of more than 35% over the past two years.” That rally may make many people who were weighing when to retire more inclined to leave the workforce.

Bhave added, “Labor‑market data has always presented a puzzle. Looking at the U.S. economy, most indicators have recovered very well after the pandemic, far faster than we originally expected. One lagging indicator is the participation rate of older workers, and in recent months that metric has slipped further.”
However, Bhave cautioned that the exit of older workers cannot be attributed entirely to the stock‑market rally.

He said, “I don’t think any single factor can fully explain this phenomenon. But given the market performance over the past few years and the cumulative gain since 2020—the S&P 500 has more than doubled—this increase in wealth is likely giving some people a stronger incentive to retire, because they think, ‘Okay, I don’t need to work any more.’”
Bhave added, “This gives people a considerable degree of confidence about retirement. Even those with relatively low risk tolerance now have a sizable buffer.”

If the market reverses, what happens to their wealth? Bhave said that even with a market pull‑back, many retirees may still have enough wealth cushion. “In that situation I think they have sufficient buffer, so they may think: the market might pull back, but as long as it isn’t a catastrophic crash, given the large wealth already accumulated, even if the market falls I’m still comfortable retiring.”

Financial advisors who serve near‑retirement clients are not surprised by this analysis. Cary Carbonaro, author of *Women and Wealth* and a certified financial planner, said the wealth effect is real.

She said, “We have experienced double‑digit stock gains in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and 2026 looks set to continue that performance. The retirement wave is occurring because of these gains, giving my clients more options than they previously had.”

Financial planner Tyson Sprick in Overland Park, Kansas, made a similar observation: “The numbers on the screen have never looked so good; some clients have gained confidence and finally decided to retire.”
He also noted that clients ask, “How long can this situation last?” and “If the market crashes, will I still be okay?”

“Therefore, we take all these factors into account and use forward‑looking financial‑planning assumptions based on current market levels. While we cannot predict the future, we do not ignore the fact that such strong returns cannot last forever.”

Even people who are not yet ready to retire are benefiting from the market boom. According to another Bank of America data set, average 401(k) balances in Q2 2026 reached $124,250, up 15% from a year earlier. About two‑thirds of employees say their current retirement‑savings progress is sufficient to retire at their ideal age and lifestyle, a 6‑point increase from last year.

items.title: DeepSeek不再獨領風騷？Meta、輝達殺入開放模型戰場
items.title_en: Meta and NVIDIA Enter Open Model Market, Challenging China's DeepSeek
paras: 中國AI實驗室近年在開放權重模型市場取得領先後，Meta(META-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)本周相繼推出可供開發者免費下載的新模型，正式加入由深度求索(DeepSeek)、月之暗面(Moonshot AI)及阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)通義千問(Qwen)主導的競爭。業界人士認為，兩大科技公司此舉等於明確宣告，美國不會把接近前沿水準的開放模型市場拱手讓給中國業者。
與OpenAI及Anthropic旗下熱門封閉模型不同，開放權重模型允許開發者下載決定AI運作與行為的參數，進行檢視、調整與部署。不過，開放權重不一定等同完整的開源，因為業者未必會同時公布訓練資料、訓練方法與原始碼。
就在上月，Meta、輝達與其他美國科技公司曾聯名呼籲政策制定者，不要對開放權重模型施加「過早限制」，即使模型來自中國也不例外。這些公司主張，開放權重AI能擴大機會、促進競爭、延續美國科技領導地位，並避免能力集中在少數企業手中。
Meta、輝達接連出招 正面迎戰中國模型
Meta周一發表Muse Glimmer，作為重新向開放生態系統釋出強大模型的策略之一。執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)並宣布，將開放最新模型Muse Spark 1.2的權重。
Muse Spark 1.2被視為可與OpenAI及Anthropic頂尖基礎模型競爭的產品，不過Meta與輝達本周率先發布的模型規模較小，主要設計為在筆電等本地裝置運行，可用於驅動裝置端數位代理。
輝達隔日推出Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，延續去年12月發表的Nemotron 3模型家族。輝達強調，其模型屬於「真正的開源」，因為公司除模型權重外，也公布相關訓練資料集及訓練技術，供開發者檢視。
Box(BOX-US)執行長Aaron Levie形容，祖克柏開放Muse Spark 1.2權重的計畫是「非常重大的事件」，Meta與輝達的最新動作已明確表態，美國將擁有接近前沿水準的開源模型。
Meta先前曾透過Llama進軍開放模型市場，但2025年4月推出的Llama 4未能獲得開發者青睞。公司隨後投入數十億美元重整AI部門，延攬Scale AI執行長Alexandr Wang領導相關業務。近期，Wang團隊陸續以Muse品牌推出封閉模型，試圖開拓新收入來源，如今又重新向開放權重路線靠攏。

政府、銀行商機龐大 Meta仍須挽回開發者信任

Meta與輝達仍須證明，在DeepSeek、月之暗面與通義千問等中國模型已廣受歡迎的市場中，美國開放模型確實能吸引足夠的開發者與企業用戶。
Levie認為，美國企業推出具競爭力的開放權重模型，可望釋放龐大需求。美國政府機構與大型銀行可能因資安、監管及資料主權疑慮，無法採用中國開放模型，但更願意嘗試Meta等本土供應商的產品。這將使Muse有機會進入過去難以觸及的敏感應用場景。
Forrester分析師Charlie Dai也表示，Meta回歸開放權重具有重要戰略意義，因為這讓美國主要前沿AI業者重新回到開放生態系統。對開發者及企業而言，開放權重有助提高透明度、客製化程度、部署彈性與資料自主性。
不過，Meta曾從開放權重轉向封閉模型，已傷害部分第三方開發者的信任。企業AI新創Uniphore執行長Umesh Sachdev表示，Meta當初改變策略，讓旗下開發者感到遭到背叛，祖克柏本周發表長達3,500字的宣言，恐怕仍不足以說服他們重新投入Meta生態系統。
Sachdev仍期待美國本土業者成功，因為更多競爭可望降低AI模型的Token使用成本，同時加快創新，最終讓消費者受惠。Dai則指出，Meta接下來不能只靠發布性能優異的模型，還必須證明有能力建立可長期維持的開發者生態系統。
開放權重AI在美國仍具有政治爭議。批評者擔心中國模型可能帶來國家安全風險，也將「蒸餾」技術視為一種潛在的智慧財產竊取手段；業界則反駁，蒸餾是廣泛用於模型改進、評估及驗證的技術。隨著Meta與輝達加入戰局，美中AI競爭也正從封閉模型效能之爭，進一步延伸至誰能掌控全球開放生態系統。
paras_en: China's AI laboratory has been leading the open weight model market in recent years, but Meta (META-US) and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) have recently released new models that can be downloaded for free by developers, officially joining the competition led by DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, and Alibaba (BABA-US) (09988-HK) (Qwen). Industry insiders believe that the two major technology companies' move is equivalent to declaring that the US will not give up the open model market to Chinese companies.

Unlike the popular closed models from OpenAI and Anthropic, open weight models allow developers to download the parameters that determine AI behavior and operation, allowing for review, adjustment, and deployment. However, open weight does not necessarily mean complete open-source, as companies may not simultaneously publish training data, training methods, and original code.

Last month, Meta, NVIDIA, and other US technology companies jointly called on policymakers not to impose 'premature restrictions' on open weight models, even if they come from China. These companies argue that open weight AI can expand opportunities, promote competition, and extend US technological leadership, while avoiding the concentration of capabilities in a few companies.
Meta and NVIDIA have successively made their moves, directly challenging Chinese models.

Meta announced Muse Glimmer on Monday as part of its strategy to release powerful models back into the open ecosystem. CEO Mark Zuckerberg also announced that the company would open the weights of its latest model, Muse Spark 1.2.

Muse Spark 1.2 is considered a product that can compete with the top-tier base models from OpenAI and Anthropic, but the models released by Meta and NVIDIA this week are smaller in scale and designed primarily for local deployment on devices such as laptops, which can be used to drive device-side digital agents.

NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning the next day, continuing its Nemotron 3 model family released in December last year. NVIDIA emphasized that its model is 'true open-source' because the company has published not only the model weights but also the related training data sets and training techniques for developers to review.

Box (BOX-US) CEO Aaron Levie described Zuckerberg's plan to open Muse Spark 1.2 weights as 'a very significant event', and Meta and NVIDIA's latest moves have clearly stated that the US will have open-source models that are close to the cutting edge.

Meta previously entered the open model market through Llama, but Llama 4, released in April 2025, failed to gain the favor of developers. The company subsequently invested tens of billions of dollars to revamp its AI department, hiring Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang to lead related business. Recently, Wang's team has released closed models under the Muse brand, trying to explore new revenue streams, and now they are returning to the open weight route.
The US government and large banks have a huge market for Meta, which still needs to regain the trust of developers.

Levie believes that US companies can release competitive open weight models, which can unlock huge demand. US government agencies and large banks may be hesitant to adopt Chinese open models due to security, regulatory, and data sovereignty concerns, but they are more willing to try products from domestic suppliers like Meta. This will give Muse a chance to enter previously inaccessible sensitive application scenarios.

Forrester analyst Charlie Dai also stated that Meta's return to open weight has important strategic significance because it allows US leading AI companies to return to the open ecosystem. For developers and enterprises, open weight can improve transparency, customization, deployment flexibility, and data sovereignty.

However, Meta has previously switched from open weight to closed models, which has damaged the trust of some third-party developers. Uniphore CEO Umesh Sachdev said that Meta's change of strategy made its developers feel betrayed, and Zuckerberg's recent 3,500-word statement may not be enough to convince them to re-enter the Meta ecosystem.

Sachdev still expects US domestic companies to succeed because more competition can reduce the cost of using AI models and accelerate innovation, ultimately benefiting consumers. Dai pointed out that Meta cannot rely solely on releasing high-performance models in the future, but must also prove its ability to establish a sustainable developer ecosystem.

Open weight AI is still a contentious issue in the US. Critics worry that Chinese models may pose national security risks and view 'distillation' as a potential intellectual property theft method; the industry argues that distillation is a widely used technique for model improvement, evaluation, and verification. As Meta and NVIDIA join the fray, the US-China AI competition is shifting from the debate over closed model performance to who can control the global open ecosystem.

items.title: DeepSeek要挑戰Claude Code！成立AI代理新團隊大舉徵才
items.title_en: DeepSeek Aims to Challenge Claude Code, Launches New AI Agent Team and Aggressively Hires
paras: 中國AI新創深度求索(DeepSeek)正公開擴大對Anthropic旗下熱門程式設計工具Claude Code的挑戰。該公司成立新的AI代理團隊，不僅開設官方社群帳號、發布多項職缺，還升級旗艦模型的代理能力，顯示業務重心正進一步轉向可自動執行複雜工作的AI代理產品。
總部位於杭州的DeepSeek近日在騰訊旗下超級應用程式微信(WeChat)開設「DeepSeek Harness Team」帳號。該帳號隸屬一家位於北京的企業，經騰訊驗證；中國企業資料庫企查查顯示，這家企業由DeepSeek控制。
「Harness」通常指建構在大型語言模型外圍的軟體框架，讓AI代理能夠使用工具、管理工作流程，並完成更複雜的任務。Anthropic等AI開發商已利用這類框架強化旗下產品，使其更有效率地處理程式設計與其他專業工作。Claude Code便是目前最受矚目的AI程式設計代理工具之一。
DeepSeek也開始為Harness團隊招募多個職位。公司在其中一則徵才公告中表示，目標是把旗下模型轉化為最先進的代理型產品，反映其不再只著重基礎模型效能，也準備強化模型與工具、工作流程及實際應用場景之間的整合。
此外，DeepSeek周三晚間透過微信官方聊天頻道宣布，已更新旗艦V4 Pro模型，進一步改善AI代理能力。新團隊成立與模型升級幾乎同步曝光，顯示DeepSeek正加速建立從底層模型到代理應用的完整產品布局。
中國AI業者目前正與美國開發商激烈競爭，希望打造能力更強、成本更低的AI工具。OpenAI的ChatGPT掀起全球生成式AI競賽後，業界焦點已逐漸從聊天機器人轉向AI代理，希望透過能夠理解指令、操作軟體並自主完成多步驟任務的產品，切入企業自動化市場。
相較一般聊天機器人，AI代理具備更明確的商業化潛力，可協助程式設計師、研究人員及其他專業人士自動處理工作，也因此成為中美AI業者新一輪競爭的關鍵戰場。DeepSeek並未在正常營業時間後回應置評請求。
paras_en: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, is publicly expanding its challenge to Anthropic's popular programming tool Claude Code. The company has formed a new AI agent team, opened an official community account, posted multiple job openings, and upgraded the agency capabilities of its flagship model, indicating that its business focus is shifting further toward AI agent products that can automatically perform complex tasks.

Headquartered in Hangzhou, DeepSeek recently opened a "DeepSeek Harness Team" account on Tencent's super app WeChat. The account is affiliated with a Beijing‑based company that has been verified by Tencent; the Chinese business registry Qichacha shows that this company is controlled by DeepSeek.

"Harness" typically refers to a software framework built around large language models that enables AI agents to use tools, manage workflows, and accomplish more complex tasks. AI developers such as Anthropic have used such frameworks to strengthen their products, making them more efficient at programming and other professional work. Claude Code is currently one of the most prominent AI programming agent tools.

DeepSeek has also begun recruiting for multiple positions on its Harness team. In one job posting, the company said its goal is to turn its models into cutting‑edge agent‑type products, reflecting a shift away from focusing solely on base model performance toward tighter integration of models with tools, workflows, and real‑world use cases.

In addition, DeepSeek announced on Wednesday evening via its official WeChat chat channel that it has updated its flagship V4 Pro model, further improving its AI agent capabilities. The near‑simultaneous reveal of the new team and model upgrade shows DeepSeek is accelerating the construction of a complete product stack from underlying models to agent applications.

Chinese AI firms are currently locked in fierce competition with U.S. developers, aiming to create more powerful and lower‑cost AI tools. After OpenAI's ChatGPT sparked a global generative‑AI race, industry attention has gradually shifted from chatbots to AI agents, with the hope of entering the enterprise automation market through products that can understand instructions, operate software, and autonomously complete multi‑step tasks.

Compared with ordinary chatbots, AI agents have clearer commercial potential, helping programmers, researchers, and other professionals automate work, and thus becoming a key battleground in the new round of U.S.–China AI competition. DeepSeek did not respond to comment requests outside of normal business hours.

items.title: 關稅壓力太棘手？蘋果延攬美航老將對接川普政府
items.title_en: Tariff Pressure Too Tricky? Apple Hires Former American Airlines Executive to Liaise with the Trump Administration
paras: 根據外媒周三(12日)報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)延攬美國航空(AAL-US)資深主管蓋頓(Nate Gatten)出任全球政府事務副總裁，借重其深厚的共和黨人脈，協助公司處理與川普政府的關係。隨著關稅與海外生產成為政策焦點，這項任命凸顯蘋果正重新調整政府關係布局。
蘋果資深副總裁暨法務長紐斯特德(Jennifer Newstead)在內部備忘錄中表示，蓋頓將於8月31日上任，常駐加州庫比蒂諾，負責領導蘋果全球政府事務團隊，並直接向她報告。前法務長兼政府事務資深副總裁亞當斯(Kate Adams)則將擔任顧問至10月1日退休。
蘋果政府事務主管一職近年歷經多次調整。相關職責過去由前美國環境保護署(EPA)署長傑克森(Lisa Jackson)掌管，她曾在歐巴馬政府任職，2013年加入蘋果後也負責環境、政策及社會倡議，協助公司推動減碳等目標。
不過，川普兩度執政使這項工作面臨新挑戰，尤其是政府試圖對海外製造產品加徵關稅，恐直接衝擊高度依賴亞洲供應鏈的蘋果。近年來，執行長庫克(Tim Cook)也更親自介入與白宮的關係。
知情人士透露，蘋果希望延攬一名能與川普政府保持一致及順暢合作的人選。蓋頓是共和黨人，2017年起擔任美國航空政府事務主管，直到本周離任；此前曾在摩根大通(JPM-US)領導全球政府關係與政策團隊，也曾在房利美(Fannie Mae)帶領負責與共和黨國會議員溝通的團隊。
蓋頓也具有房地產相關經驗，可望在蘋果擴大零售門市與其他營運據點之際提供協助。他上任後預計與庫克密切合作。現任政府事務主管阿曼(Nick Ammann)則將改向蓋頓報告，團隊其他主管波德利(Tim Powderly)、布朗(Matt Brown)與奧吉爾(Mike Orgill)也將納入其管理。
這項任命是蘋果高層世代交替的最新一環。公司本周也通知員工，長期負責Apple Pay與Wallet服務的主管即將卸任。庫克則預計9月1日把執行長職務交給硬體工程主管特納斯(John Ternus)，自己轉任執行董事長，並繼續參與政府關係事務，包括維繫與川普政府的互動。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports on Wednesday (the 12th), Apple (AAPL-US) has hired Nate Gatten, a senior executive from American Airlines (AAL-US), as Vice President of Global Government Affairs, leveraging his deep Republican network to help the company manage its relationship with the Trump administration. As tariffs and overseas production become policy focal points, the appointment underscores Apple’s reshaping of its government‑relations strategy.

Apple senior vice president and general counsel Jennifer Newstead said in an internal memo that Gatten will assume the role on August 31, based in Cupertino, California, where he will lead Apple’s global government affairs team and report directly to her. Former general counsel and senior vice president of government affairs Kate Adams will serve as a consultant until her retirement on October 1.

Apple’s government‑affairs leadership has been restructured several times in recent years. The responsibilities were previously held by former EPA administrator Lisa Jackson, who served in the Obama administration and, after joining Apple in 2013, oversaw environmental, policy and social‑impact initiatives, helping the company pursue carbon‑reduction goals.

However, the two‑time Trump administration presents new challenges, especially as the government seeks to impose tariffs on overseas‑manufactured products, which could directly hit Apple’s heavy reliance on Asian supply chains. In recent years CEO Tim Cook has also become more personally involved in relations with the White House.

Sources familiar with the matter said Apple wants someone who can align with and work smoothly with the Trump administration. Gatten, a Republican, has been American Airlines’ head of government affairs since 2017 and left the role this week; he previously led JPMorgan’s (JPM-US) global government relations and policy team and headed a team at Fannie Mae that communicated with Republican members of Congress.

Gatten also brings real‑estate experience that could help Apple as it expands retail stores and other operational sites. After taking the post he is expected to work closely with Cook. Current government‑affairs chief Nick Ammann will now report to Gatten, and other team leaders Tim Powderly, Matt Brown and Mike Orgill will fall under his management.

The appointment is the latest part of Apple’s senior‑leadership generational turnover. The company also told employees this week that the long‑time head of Apple Pay and Wallet will soon step down. Cook plans to hand over the CEO role to hardware engineering chief John Ternus on September 1, become executive chairman, and continue to be involved in government‑relations work, including maintaining interaction with the Trump administration.

items.title: 川普發文也能賣到月費10萬美元！Truth Social遭控違憲
items.title_en: Trump’s Post Can Fetch $100,000 a Month: Truth Social Accused of Unconstitutional Practices
paras: 美國總統川普因旗下社群平台Truth Social推出高價資訊服務而遭到提告。新聞機構The Intercept Media與非營利組織新聞自由基金會(Freedom of the Press Foundation)周三向紐約曼哈頓聯邦法院提起訴訟，要求阻止川普媒體暨科技集團(Trump Media & Technology Group)(DJT-US)向付費客戶出售川普貼文的優先存取權，批評這項安排既「腐敗」又違憲。
川普媒體7月宣布推出Truth API，讓訂閱者以機器可讀取的資料流，在數毫秒內取得Truth Social熱門帳號公開發布的貼文。該服務月費介於6萬至10萬美元，主打讓客戶更快收到可能撼動金融市場的川普貼文。
川普是川普媒體最大股東，其持股透過Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust持有，價值約10億美元，信託由長子小唐納．川普(Donald Trump Jr.)管理。原告因此主張，川普可能藉由出售官方資訊的時間優勢，為自己的企業創造收益。

花每月10萬美元搶快 政策消息恐成付費特權

訴狀指出，川普經常透過Truth Social宣布政府政策、軍事行動及其他重大決策，相關貼文足以引發金融市場波動。自2025年1月重新入主白宮以來，川普已在平台發布約9,000至11,000則貼文，其中許多內容並未同步透過白宮其他管道公布，使Truth Social成為取得部分官方消息的唯一來源。
原告批評，川普向有能力支付高額費用的客戶提供官方公告的提前存取權，不僅缺乏正當政府利益，也可能違反美國憲法第一修正案及第五修正案。訴狀主張，第一修正案保障媒體平等取得總統公開言論的權利，政府不能將提前接觸公共資訊的機會作為商品出售。
目前Truth API涵蓋Truth Social最熱門的10個帳號。除了川普之外，還包括白宮、副總統范斯(JD Vance)、聯邦調查局(FBI)局長巴特爾(Kash Patel)、白宮發言人李威特(Karoline Leavitt)、運輸部長達菲(Sean Duffy)，以及衛生部長小羅勃．甘迺迪(Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)等政府官員與機構。
The Intercept表示，無法同步取得官方消息將損害其新聞採訪與即時報導能力。新聞自由基金會則營運一項追蹤川普批評媒體貼文的計畫，同樣主張付費客戶享有的速度優勢會妨礙其工作。

川普媒體稱僅快「一小部分」 已簽逾10份合約

川普媒體執行長麥根(Kevin McGurn)本周在財報電話會議上表示，Truth API提供的是已經公開發布的貼文，付費客戶只會「快一小部分」取得資訊。公司目前已簽署超過10份客戶合約，每份合約月費大致介於6萬至10萬美元。
麥根透露，公司正與超大規模雲端服務商、部分大型新聞機構及大型語言模型開發商洽談合作。Truth API下一階段預計擴大第三方發布管道，可能納入新聞資訊流、金融數據終端與專業刊物，藉此提升這項業務的能見度。
川普媒體也反駁，總統資訊早已透過眾多平台與新聞機構傳播，其中不少業者同樣提供付費API服務。公司並稱Truth Social是在川普遭到其他平台封鎖後，為保障言論自由而成立。
兩名原告要求法院宣告，川普政府僅透過Truth Social發布官方資訊的做法違憲，並禁止政府繼續以此方式散布消息。被告除川普外，還包括經常代川普發布貼文的總統行政助理哈普(Natalie Harp)、白宮副幕僚長斯卡維諾(Dan Scavino)、總統行政辦公室及白宮辦公室。
這項爭議發生之際，川普媒體本周稍早公布第二季虧損2.38億美元，主要受到公司持有的加密貨幣價格重挫拖累。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is being sued over his social‑media platform Truth Social’s high‑priced information service. The Intercept Media and the nonprofit Freedom of the Press Foundation filed a complaint Wednesday in the Manhattan federal court, seeking to block Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT‑US) from selling paying customers priority access to Trump’s posts, calling the arrangement both "corrupt" and unconstitutional.

Trump Media announced in July that it would launch a Truth API, allowing subscribers to receive, via a machine‑readable data stream, posts from the platform’s most popular accounts within milliseconds. The service costs between $60,000 and $100,000 per month and is marketed as giving clients faster access to Trump posts that could move financial markets.

Trump is the largest shareholder of Trump Media, holding his stake through the Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust, valued at roughly $1 billion and managed by his eldest son Donald Trump Jr. The plaintiffs argue that Trump could use the time advantage of selling official information to generate profit for his own businesses.

Paying $100,000 a month to be first: policy news may become a paid privilege. The complaint notes that Trump frequently uses Truth Social to announce government policies, military actions and other major decisions, and those posts can trigger market volatility. Since retaking the White House in January 2025, Trump has posted roughly 9,000‑11,000 times on the platform, many of which were not simultaneously released through other White House channels, making Truth Social the sole source for some official information.

The plaintiffs criticize that Trump is giving paying customers early access to official announcements, which they say lacks a legitimate governmental interest and may violate the First and Fifth Amendments. They contend the First Amendment guarantees the press equal access to the president’s public statements, and the government cannot sell the opportunity to see public information ahead of others.

The Truth API currently covers the ten most popular Truth Social accounts. In addition to Trump, it includes the White House, Vice President JD Vance, FBI Director Kash Patel, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, and Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., among other officials and agencies.

The Intercept says that being unable to obtain official news in real time would damage its reporting and breaking‑news capabilities. The Freedom of the Press Foundation runs a project tracking Trump’s critical‑of‑media posts and likewise argues that the speed advantage for paying clients would hinder its work.

Trump Media says the speed boost is only a "small fraction" and that it has already signed more than ten contracts. CEO Kevin McGurn told analysts on a earnings call this week that the Truth API delivers already‑public posts, and paying customers receive the information only "a little bit faster." Each contract is priced roughly between $60,000 and $100,000 per month.

McGurn disclosed that the company is in talks with hyperscale cloud providers, several large news organizations and major large‑language‑model developers. The next phase of the Truth API is expected to expand third‑party distribution channels, potentially adding news feeds, financial‑data terminals and specialist publications to increase the service’s visibility.

Trump Media also counters that presidential information is already disseminated across many platforms and news outlets, many of which also offer paid API services. The company says Truth Social was created after Trump was blocked on other platforms to safeguard free speech.

The two plaintiffs ask the court to declare unconstitutional the practice of the Trump administration of releasing official information solely via Truth Social and to bar the government from continuing to use that method. Defendants include, besides Trump, presidential aide Natalie Harp, who often posts on his behalf, White House deputy chief of staff Dan Scavino, the Office of the President, and the White House Office.
The dispute comes as Trump Media reported a Q2 loss of $238 million earlier this week, mainly due to a sharp decline in the value of its cryptocurrency holdings.

items.title: 微軟Win 11授權費傳已最高調漲10% OEM廠首當其衝
items.title_en: Microsoft Windows 11 License Fees Said to Have Jumped Up to 10%—OEMs Hit First
paras: 全球消費性電子產業今年深陷漲價壓力，記憶體、邏輯晶片等半導體供應短缺，不僅推升硬體成本，漲價潮如今更延燒至軟體。業界消息指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 已將 Windows 11 授權費調高最多 10%，且此次漲價並非針對 DIY 用戶，而是直接影響銷售整機的 OEM 廠商，進一步加重成本負擔。
據個人電腦OEM業者透露，微軟雖然每年皆會慣例性地微調授權費，但今年的漲幅明顯擴大，平均達到7%至10%。此外，微軟的授權費調漲並非一成不變，而是根據處理器效能採取階梯式計價，CPU越高端，費用就越高。
儘管從整體結構來看，微軟的授權費對整機價格的影響，遠不及記憶體和固態硬碟（SSD）價格的飆漲幅度，但它仍然是導致終端電腦購買成本比以往更高的一個重要因素。
面對「軟硬體齊漲」的雙重壓力，PC品牌廠今年營運挑戰不斷。消息稱，華碩和宏碁等大廠將在今年稍後將價格再上調約5%，且與2025年第四季相比，華碩產品的平均漲幅已達到30%。
有PC品牌主管坦言，雖然產品售價已陸續反映本次微軟調漲的授權費，但由於今年其他關鍵零組件漲幅實在過大，消費者與企業對於單一成本項目的變動已較難產生明顯感受。
雪上加霜的是，近階段個人電腦出貨量也出現了明顯下滑。根據Counterpoint Research報告顯示，2026年第二季全球個人電腦市場出貨量年減約4%至4.9%，這是自2025年第一季度以來全球PC市場首次出現下滑。
聯想集團(00992-HK) 、惠普(HPQ-US) 、戴爾(DELL-US) 等主要生產商均面臨銷售量下滑的困境，蘋果則成為少數出貨量逆勢增加10%以上的廠商。
雖然持續攀升的價格理論上能提升企業的利潤，但Counterpoint指出，Windows系統遷移周期和AI PC普及雖然仍在支撐部分商業換機需求，持續攀升的記憶體價格和零組件成本卻正在兩頭擠壓OEM廠商。
業界擔憂，如果這種價格上漲趨勢持續失控，消費者未來可能不再傾向於購買新電腦，這對整體產業來說無疑是個巨大的隱憂。
paras_en: The global consumer electronics industry is under intense price‑increase pressure this year, with shortages of memory, logic chips and other semiconductors driving up hardware costs, and the inflation wave now spreading to software. Industry sources say Microsoft (MSFT‑US) has raised Windows 11 licensing fees by as much as 10%, and the hike is not aimed at DIY users but directly impacts OEMs that sell complete systems, further burdening their cost base.

According to a PC OEM, Microsoft typically makes small annual adjustments to its licensing fees, but this year’s increase is markedly larger, averaging between 7% and 10%. Moreover, the fee hike is tiered by processor performance—the higher‑end the CPU, the higher the charge.

Although, in the overall cost structure, Microsoft’s licensing fees affect the final price of a system far less than the soaring prices of memory and solid‑state drives (SSDs), they remain a significant factor that makes end‑user computer purchase costs higher than before.

Facing a “software‑and‑hardware‑both‑rising” double pressure, PC brands are confronting continual operational challenges this year. Sources say major makers such as Asus and Acer will raise their prices by roughly another 5% later this year, and compared with Q4 2025, the average price increase for Asus products has already reached 30%.

A PC brand executive admitted that although product prices have begun to reflect Microsoft’s licensing fee increase, the magnitude of price hikes in other key components this year is so large that consumers and enterprises find it hard to notice the impact of any single cost item.

Adding to the strain, recent PC shipment volumes have shown a clear decline. Counterpoint Research reports that global PC shipments in Q2 2026 fell year‑over‑year by about 4% to 4.9%, marking the first decline in the global PC market since Q1 2025.

Major manufacturers such as Lenovo Group (00992‑HK), HP (HPQ‑US) and Dell (DELL‑US) are all facing falling sales, while Apple is one of the few companies whose shipments have risen by more than 10% against the trend.

Although rising prices theoretically can boost corporate margins, Counterpoint notes that the Windows migration cycle and the spread of AI PCs still support some business‑upgrade demand, but the continuously climbing memory prices and component costs are squeezing OEMs from both ends.

The industry worries that if this price‑increase trend continues unchecked, consumers may become reluctant to buy new computers in the future, which would pose a huge hidden risk to the entire sector.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉溫和CPI消除升息疑慮 費半強漲近2.5% 記憶體類股噴高
paras: 美國7月通膨略為降溫，強化聯準會9月維持利率不變的預期，加上AI基礎設施及記憶體類股強勢上漲，美股週三 (12 日) 多收高。費半指數勁揚近 2.5%，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，標普500指數漲0.26%，道瓊指數幾乎收在平盤。
美國7月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 年增3.4%，符合市場預期，低於6月的3.5%；月增率則為0.1%。通膨持續降溫後，交易員轉而押注聯準會9月將按兵不動，扭轉前一日升息與維持利率不變機率約各半的局面。
不過，美國通膨率仍高於聯準會2%目標，加上中東局勢持續推高能源價格及美債殖利率，使聯準會官員對是否升息仍存在分歧。
美國與伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽的談判持續陷入僵局。美方週二對一艘試圖穿越阿曼灣、懸掛巴拿馬國旗的船隻開火，進一步加劇市場對原油供應的擔憂，布蘭特原油期貨一度逼近每桶90美元。
油價上漲也推高美國汽油價格。全美普通汽油平均價格週三升至每加侖4.03美元，較一個月前上漲約0.16美元，創歷年8月中旬同期新高。
美股週三 (12 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭盡墨。Meta (META-US) 下跌 3.38%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.87%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 微跌 0.08%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.26%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 1.83%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.82%；博通 (AVGO-US) 微跌 0.01%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 3.03%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 大漲 4.29%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.24%。
記憶體與儲存類股同步走高。美光科技 (MU-US) 大漲 4.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 3.69%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 勁揚 5.76%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 大漲 7.03%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆 9.01%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.68%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.63%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.95%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 微跌 0.12%。
企業新聞
溫蒂漢堡 (WEN-US) 瘋漲14.70%至每股 8.66 美元，英國《金融時報》引述消息人士報導，億萬富豪投資人Nelson Peltz 旗下 Trian Fund Management 正準備提出收購要約，計劃將溫蒂漢堡私有化。
全球AI伺服器大廠美超微 (SMCI-US) 暴漲19.02%至每股 37.61 美元，其第四季業績優於預期，同時發布樂觀的第一季財測，顯示 AI 伺服器需求仍然穩健。
AI 雲端運算公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 猛升 19.28% 至每股 107.73 美元，公司第二季調整後營業利益率達 5%，優於市場預期，營收較去年同期成長逾一倍。
Nebius Group (NBIS-US) 週三漲幅高逾34% 至每股 259.20 美元。這家 AI 基礎設施公司公布的稅前息前折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 與營收均優於 FactSet 調查的分析師預期，毛利率表現也超出市場預估。

items.title: 川普宣布白宮發言人月底離任 萊維特生兩胎後轉任外部顧問備戰期中選舉
items.title_en: Trump Announces White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Leave Post at End of Month
paras: 美國總統川普周三(12日)宣布, 白宮新聞秘書萊維特(Karoline Leavitt)將於8月底離開現職, 理由是希望有更多時間陪伴家人。這項人事異動距離11月3日舉行的美國期中選舉僅約3個月, 也意味著川普政府的核心新聞傳播團隊將在選戰前夕出現重大調整。
川普在Truth Social發文表示, 萊維特將於本月底離開白宮新聞秘書職務, 以便花更多時間陪伴年幼子女與家人, 並稱自己完全理解且尊重她的決定。川普同時表示, 萊維特未來將成為他的「頂級外部顧問」之一, 並在共和黨內繼續扮演具有影響力的聲音, 協助共和黨「改寫歷史」並贏得期中選舉。
萊維特則在社群平台X發文表示, 過去一年半擔任白宮新聞秘書是她一生中最榮耀、也最具冒險性的經歷之一。她並未透露離任後是否會加入特定競選團隊, 但川普已明確表示, 她離開白宮並不代表退出其政治核心圈, 而是轉往白宮之外擔任重要政治顧問。
這項宣布也具有特殊時間背景。2026年期中選舉將於11月3日舉行, 共和黨目前正積極整合川普陣營、共和黨全國委員會及各州候選人的競選策略。Axios 7月報導指出, 川普在白宮內外的主要政治顧問當時已召開會議, 檢視民調、競選訊息及期中選舉策略, 川普的超級政治行動委員會及共和黨全國委員會當時合計掌握約5.3億美元資金, 並開始規劃如何、何時以及在哪些選區投入資源。
萊維特在川普政治陣營中的角色也早已超越傳統白宮發言人。她加入川普2024年總統競選團隊, 之後擔任政權交接團隊發言人, 最終獲川普任命為白宮新聞秘書, 成為美國史上最年輕的白宮新聞秘書。她自川普第二任期開始後, 成為政府對外傳達政策、回應媒體質疑及捍衛川普施政的重要人物。
萊維特近年也成為川普政府高度曝光的政治人物。白宮官方資料顯示, 她直到今年7月仍持續主持白宮例行媒體簡報, 7月23日也在白宮詹姆斯·布雷迪新聞簡報室向媒體說明政府政策及回答問題。
她此次離任與家庭因素也有直接關聯。今年5月, 萊維特宣布生下女兒Viviana, 她與丈夫Nicholas Riccio另育有一名年幼兒子Niko。她在生產前曾開始休產假, 並在5月宣布女兒出生。
萊維特離任後, 白宮將面臨新聞傳播工作的重新布局。她在川普政府第二任期擔任發言人約一年半, 在此期間頻繁代表白宮出席媒體簡報, 並經常成為川普政策與政治立場的主要辯護者。她的離開發生在期中選舉進入最後衝刺前夕, 因此外界也將關注川普會任命誰接替這項高度政治化的職位。
川普目前正積極介入共和黨期中選舉布局。美聯社今年5月分析指出, 川普已更加緊密掌握共和黨提名過程, 並積極為部分候選人背書, 但共和黨在11月大選仍面臨選民對川普第二任期及經濟表現的考驗。共和黨策略人士認為, 川普如何運用政治資源以及如何動員其支持者, 將成為期中選舉的重要變數。
川普近期也持續要求共和黨國會領袖加快推動其政治議程。例如7月底, 川普要求參院多數黨領袖Thune取消8月休會, 留在華府推動一項要求選民提供公民身分證明及投票時出示附照片身分證件的法案, 顯示川普正試圖在期中選舉前進一步凝聚共和黨政治議題。
對川普而言, 萊維特離開白宮雖會造成日常新聞運作上的人事變動, 但她轉任外部顧問後仍將繼續參與共和黨政治工作, 反而可能讓她從政府新聞發言角色轉向更直接的選戰及政治宣傳工作。尤其距離期中選舉僅剩不到3個月, 川普已明確將她定位為協助共和黨贏得選舉的重要政治盟友。
paras_en: US President Trump announced on Wednesday (12th) that White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt will leave her position at the end of August, citing a desire to spend more time with her family.

Trump posted on Truth Social that Leavitt will leave her position as White House Press Secretary at the end of the month to spend more time with her young children and family, and stated that he fully understands and respects her decision.
Leavitt posted on social media platform X that her time as White House Press Secretary over the past year and a half has been one of the most honored and adventurous experiences of her life.

This announcement also has a special timing background. The midterm elections in 2026 will be held on November 3rd, and the Republican Party is currently actively integrating Trump's team, the Republican National Committee, and candidates from various states into their election strategy.

Leavitt's role in Trump's political team has already exceeded that of a traditional White House Press Secretary. She joined Trump's 2024 presidential campaign team, then served as the spokesperson for the transition team, and was eventually appointed as White House Press Secretary, becoming the youngest White House Press Secretary in US history.

Leavitt has also become a highly exposed political figure in recent years. Official White House data shows that she continued to host White House regular press briefings until July of this year, and on July 23rd, she explained government policies and answered questions in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room.

Her decision to leave her position is also directly related to family factors. In May, Leavitt announced the birth of her daughter Viviana, and she and her husband Nicholas Riccio also have a young son Niko.

After Leavitt's departure, the White House will face a reorganization of its news dissemination work. She has served as a spokesperson for the White House for about a year and a half during Trump's second term, frequently representing the White House at press briefings and often becoming the main defender of Trump's policies and political positions.

Trump is currently actively intervening in the Republican Party's midterm election layout. A Reuters analysis in May noted that Trump has tightened his grip on the Republican nomination process and is actively endorsing some candidates, but the Republican Party still faces a test of voters' perceptions of Trump's second term and economic performance in the November election.

Trump has also recently continued to demand that Republican congressional leaders accelerate their political agenda. For example, at the end of July, Trump asked Senate Majority Leader Thune to cancel the August recess and stay in Washington to push through a bill requiring voters to provide proof of citizenship and show a photo ID when voting, showing that Trump is trying to further consolidate Republican political issues before the midterm elections.

For Trump, Leavitt's departure from the White House may cause daily news operations to change, but she will continue to participate in Republican Party political work as an external advisor, and may transition from her role as a government spokesperson to more direct election and political promotion work. With less than three months to go before the midterm elections, Trump has clearly positioned her as an important political ally to help the Republican Party win the election.

items.title: 日元兩周內吐回干預漲幅一半 為何美日干預仍難解基本面壓力？
items.title_en: Why Is It Still Hard for US‑Japan Intervention to Overcome Fundamental Pressure Even After the Yen Gives Back Half of Its Gains in Two Weeks?
paras: 自美日兩國進行歷史性匯市干預帶動日元反彈至今，才短短不到兩周，日元漲幅已經回吐約一半，凸顯基本面力量愈來愈難以透過短期措施扭轉的現況。
日元目前回落到1美元兌159日元以上。在美日干預前，日元一度貶破163，干預過後最高曾升到155。
Monex集團專家董事Jesper Koll說：「干預已經嚇到市場，但並沒有阻止金融市場的規律，也就是資金會流向報酬率最高的地方……只要日本資金成本低於海外報酬率，套利交易就會重新出現。」

日元升值空間受制於美日報酬率差

根本原因在於日本與美國之間的報酬率差距。日本借貸成本仍遠低於美國及其他市場，促使投資人以低成本借入日元，再投入高收益資產，形成典型的日元套利交易(carry trade，也稱利差交易)。
目前的大環境也不利日元，美國公債殖利率走升，有利於美元，再加上油價維持在高檔，對日本這種高度仰賴能源進口的國家尤其不利。
Koll認為，干預確實成功讓投機交易不至於過度升溫，也提高放空日元交易者所承擔的風險，但並未消除支撐美元那個最基本的殖利率優勢。
State Street Global Advisors資深固定收益與外匯策略師Masahiko Loo說：「干預成功的重塑市場心理，也展現美日兩國政策協調罕見的強度。但目前還沒有消除支撐美元的殖利率優勢。」
美日殖利率差距仍然明顯：基準的10年期美國公債殖利率目前為4.686%，日本10年期公債殖利率則為2.846%，這代表投資人持有美國公債仍享有可觀的報酬誘因。
Loo說：「與其說這是成功改變基本面，不如說是成功放緩投機交易。」
目前市場把目光聚焦在日本銀行(BOJ，央行)，和預定9月召開的下一次貨幣決策會議。
Koll表示，對投資人而言，更大的衝擊並非匯市干預本身，而是日銀不願更積極收緊貨幣政策。這也讓外界質疑，決策者的行動空間是否被銀行體系問題或日本龐大的公共債務負擔限縮住了。
在日本利率沒有進一步走高、或者美國殖利率沒有下滑的情況下，投資人仍有誘因將資金投入海外市場。
Lombard Odier亞洲區投資長John Wood表示，最新一輪干預可能只帶來「有限的時間效果」，他認為日銀可能至少還需要升息兩次，才能遏制日元持續走弱的趨勢。

日元面臨多重逆風

不過，利率可能只是其中一部分原因。法國東方匯理銀行(Crédit Agricole CIB)指出，更深層的問題在於美日兩國之間的「投資力量不對稱」：美國對人工智慧(AI)及其他領域的大規模投資，持續吸引全球資金流入，但日本首相高市早苗規劃的公私部門投資計畫，目前仍尚未完全實現。
該銀行表示：「要修正日元疲弱的問題，需要的不是升息，而是擴大投資。」
這代表日元若要出現可持續的升值行情，最終仍需讓日本本身的資產變得更具吸引力，鼓勵日本國內儲蓄留在國內，而不是追逐海外報酬。
現階段來看，匯市干預的作用與其說是扭轉日元貶勢，不如說是避免日元加速貶值。

160日元成政治紅線

State Street的Loo表示，160日元已成為「政治上的紅線」，如果日元再次快速貶破這一關卡，可能促使當局再次進場干預。
Loo說：「我不排除再次干預的可能性，尤其是如果日元走勢加快或失序。但最終而言，干預只能爭取時間，真正需要發揮作用的仍是日銀貨幣政策正常化，最快可能從9月開始。」
華府與東京也試圖透過強調聯準會(Fed)提供的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，進一步強化干預的威力。該機制能讓日本以美國公債作為擔保取得美元流動性，降低日本為籌措干預資金而出售美國公債的需求。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)已表示支持擴大這項金融安全網。這可能提高押注日元貶值的成本，但並不代表背後的套利交易邏輯會因此消失。
Koll表示：「嚇阻市場很容易，但要讓市場跟著政策走，需要改變誘因，也需要信任。」
paras_en: Since the historic currency‑market intervention by the United States and Japan sparked a rebound in the yen, in less than two weeks the yen has already given back about half of its rise, highlighting how increasingly difficult it is for short‑term measures to reverse the underlying fundamentals.
The yen has now slipped back to above ¥159 per US$1. Before the intervention, the yen had fallen past ¥163, and after the intervention it briefly rose as high as ¥155.

Jesper Koll, expert director at Monex Group, said: “The intervention scared the market, but it did not stop the natural law of financial markets, which is that capital flows to the highest‑returning places… As long as Japanese funding costs are lower than overseas returns, arbitrage trades will re‑emerge.”

The yen’s upside is constrained by the US‑Japan yield gap. The root cause is the yield differential between Japan and the United States. Japan’s borrowing costs remain far below those in the US and other markets, prompting investors to borrow yen cheaply and invest in higher‑yielding assets, creating the classic yen carry trade.
The broader environment also hurts the yen: rising US Treasury yields support the dollar, and high oil prices are especially detrimental to Japan, which relies heavily on energy imports.

Koll believes the intervention succeeded in preventing speculative trades from overheating and increased the risk for those shorting the yen, but it did not eliminate the fundamental yield advantage that underpins the dollar.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income and FX strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said: “The intervention successfully reshaped market psychology and demonstrated an unusually strong coordination between US and Japanese policies. Yet it has not removed the yield advantage that supports the dollar.”

The US‑Japan yield gap remains stark: the benchmark 10‑year US Treasury yield is about 4.686%, while Japan’s 10‑year yield is roughly 2.846%, meaning investors still enjoy a sizable return incentive from holding US bonds.
Loo added: “Rather than saying this changed the fundamentals, it’s more accurate to say it slowed speculative trading.”
Market attention is now focused on the Bank of Japan and the next monetary policy meeting scheduled for September.

Koll noted that for investors the bigger shock is not the FX intervention itself but the BOJ’s reluctance to tighten policy more aggressively. This raises doubts whether policymakers’ room for action is constrained by banking‑system issues or Japan’s massive public‑debt burden.
Without higher Japanese rates or lower US yields, investors still have an incentive to allocate capital to overseas markets.

John Wood, head of Asian investments at Lombard Odier, said the latest round of intervention may only provide a “limited‑time effect” and that the BOJ likely needs at least two more rate hikes to curb the yen’s continued weakness.

The yen faces multiple headwinds. However, rates may be only part of the story. Crédit Agricole CIB pointed out a deeper issue: an “asymmetric investment power” between the US and Japan, with massive US spending on AI and other sectors drawing global capital, while Prime Minister Kishida’s public‑private investment plan remains only partially implemented.
The bank said: “Fixing the yen’s weakness requires not rate hikes but expanding investment.”
That means for the yen to achieve a sustainable appreciation, Japan’s own assets must become more attractive, encouraging domestic savings to stay at home rather than chase overseas returns.
At this stage, the role of FX intervention is less about reversing yen depreciation and more about preventing an accelerated decline.
¥160 has become a political red line. State Street’s Loo said ¥160 is now a “political red line”; a rapid breach could prompt authorities to intervene again.

Loo added: “I don’t rule out another intervention, especially if the yen’s move speeds up or becomes disorderly. Ultimately, intervention only buys time; the real driver must be BOJ policy normalization, which could start as early as September.”

Washington and Tokyo are also trying to boost the impact of intervention by emphasizing the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities Repo (FIMA) facility, which lets Japan obtain dollar liquidity using US Treasuries as collateral, reducing the need to sell US bonds to fund intervention.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has voiced support for expanding this financial safety net. It may raise the cost of betting on yen depreciation, but it does not eliminate the underlying arbitrage logic.
Koll concluded: “Deterring the market is easy, but getting the market to follow policy requires changing incentives and building trust.”

items.title: USD/JPY：美元逐步逼近160日圓，市場對干預的期待降溫，CPI數據即將公佈
items.title_en: USD/JPY: US Dollar Edges Closer to 160 Yen, Market Expectations for Intervention Cool Down, CPI Data to Be Released
paras: 要點：

美元兌日圓升向160日圓
市場對干預的擔憂降溫
CPI報告即將公佈


東京與華盛頓曾將美元兌日圓從164日圓打壓至155日圓。但僅僅一週後，美元多頭已經開始重新靠近這個危險區域。
歷史性干預措施逐漸失去效力

週三，USDJPY升至約159.44日圓，逼近心理關卡160日圓。
在東京與華盛頓聯手將匯價從接近40年高點的164日圓拉回至155日圓後，日圓已回吐近一半由干預措施帶動的漲幅。
這次干預作為短期衝擊的效果相當驚人，但要扭轉長期趨勢，效果就沒那麼明顯了。
當局拋售外幣、買進日圓，迫使看空日圓的部位平倉。當這波軋空行情結束後，美日利差又悄悄恢復主導地位。
日本利率仍遠低於美國，持續鼓勵套利交易：借入低利率的日圓，再買進收益率較高的美元資產。
只要這樣的報酬仍具吸引力，交易員就有動機重新建立日圓空頭部位 — 即使當局已展現出對此高度不滿，而且干預成本十分高昂。


美國通膨將成為下一個關鍵

週三將公佈7月CPI，經濟學家預期整體CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%。剔除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI預估月增0.2%、年增2.5%。
如果通膨數據高於預期，尤其核心CPI達到0.3%或更高，可能強化市場對聯準會9月升息的預期。美國殖利率上升將提高美元資產的吸引力，可能推動美元/日圓突破160日圓。
若通膨降溫，則可能支持聯準會暫停升息，壓低美債殖利率，並讓日圓獲得喘息空間。7月就業人數減少23,000人，已經是不利於進一步緊縮政策的訊號。


160日圓將成為政策可信度的關卡

從技術面來看，160日圓不只是一般的阻力位，更像是一條政策警戒線。如果匯價明確突破，可能重新上看163.70–164日圓；但漲勢越快，再次遭到干預的風險也越高。美元多頭可能看對方向，卻仍可能因當局出手的時機而遭到重創。
初步下方支撐位落在158和157日圓附近，其後則是干預後的155日圓區域。如果跌破這一水準，將顯示當局的干預可能已經產生較持久的效果。
干預並非完全沒有效果；它確實會改變市場部位、波動率，以及做空日圓的成本。但如果美日利差沒有縮小，這就像是把沙灘球壓進水裡。現在，CPI將決定這顆球能否繼續被壓在水下 — 還是再次狠狠彈回160日圓。

paras_en: Key points: US dollar rises towards 160 yen, market concerns about intervention ease, CPI report to be released.

The US dollar has risen towards 160 yen, with market concerns about intervention easing. Tokyo and Washington had previously pushed the dollar-yen rate from 164 yen to 155 yen, but the dollar has already begun to reapproach this danger zone just a week later.

Historic intervention measures are gradually losing their effectiveness. On Wednesday, USDJPY rose to around 159.44 yen, approaching the psychological barrier of 160 yen. The yen has already retreated nearly half of the rise brought about by the intervention measures.

After the authorities sold foreign currencies and bought yen, forcing short-sellers to close their positions, the market's bearish sentiment on the yen began to dissipate. However, the US-Japan interest rate differential, which has been a major driver of the market, has resumed its dominant position.

The US inflation rate will be the next key factor. On Wednesday, the July CPI report is expected to show a 0.1% monthly increase and a 3.4% annual increase. Excluding volatile food and energy prices, the core CPI is expected to rise 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annually.

If the inflation data exceeds expectations, especially if the core CPI reaches 0.3% or higher, it may strengthen market expectations for a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve. A rise in US interest rates would increase the attractiveness of dollar assets, potentially pushing the dollar-yen rate above 160 yen.

items.title: 干預疑慮籠罩市場 美元兌日元周三劇烈波動 一度失守159關卡
items.title_en: Market Volatility Looms Amid Intervention Concerns: USD/JPY Sees Sharp Fluctuations on Wednesday
paras: 日元周三(12日)傍晚大幅波動，美元兌日元盤中一度失守159關卡，至158.59附近，隨後回升至159.06附近。
在美日於7月底聯合干預匯市之後，日元於8月重回貶勢，主要受中東地區長期不穩定局勢影響，價格攀升至每桶84美元以上。由於日本高度依賴能源進口，油價飆漲引發市場對日本貿易收支惡化的強烈擔憂，進而帶動拋售日元、買入美元的趨勢，同時，美國利率維持高位，也進一步支撐了美元強勢。
這使得周三早盤日元仍然偏弱，一度觸及159.46，為近兩周以來的低點。8月至今，日元是G10主要貨幣中唯一兌美元走弱的貨幣。
然而，市場人士對7月31日美日協同干預的記憶猶新，對當局可能隨時出手干預，保持高度警惕，這種「干預恐懼」也限制了日元的貶勢。
展望後市，分析人士指出，只要原油高價與日本財政結構問題等根本性因素未變，日元的貶值趨勢恐將持續。然而，受制於即將公布的美國通膨數據不確定性以及日本政府的干預風險，市場短期內在160關卡前顯得相當謹慎。
paras_en: The Japanese yen experienced sharp fluctuations on Wednesday evening (12th), with the USD/JPY rate briefly falling below the 159 threshold to 158.59, before rebounding to around 159.06.

Following the joint intervention by the US and Japan in the foreign exchange market at the end of July, the yen returned to a depreciation trend in August, primarily due to the prolonged instability in the Middle East region, causing prices to rise above $84 per barrel. As Japan heavily relies on energy imports, the surge in oil prices has raised concerns about Japan's trade balance worsening, leading to a trend of selling yen and buying US dollars. Additionally, the US maintaining high interest rates has further supported the strength of the US dollar.

This has resulted in the yen remaining weak in the early morning session on Wednesday, briefly touching 159.46, which is the lowest point in nearly two weeks. Since August, the yen is the only G10 major currency to have depreciated against the US dollar.

However, market participants remain vigilant about the possibility of authorities intervening at any time, given the recent memory of the joint intervention on July 31st. This 'intervention fear' has also limited the yen's depreciation trend.

Looking ahead, analysts point out that as long as the fundamental factors such as high oil prices and Japan's fiscal structure issues remain unchanged, the yen's depreciation trend is likely to continue. However, due to the uncertainty surrounding the upcoming US inflation data and the risk of Japanese government intervention, the market is cautious in the short term and is unlikely to break through the 160 threshold.

items.title: 〈台幣〉外資連續買超台股 台幣偏強整理收32.246元 升值3.2分
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Continues to Strengthen as Foreign Investors Buy Stocks
paras: 隨著外資近日連續買超台股，新台幣今(12)日偏強整理，終場收在32.246元，升值3.2分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值13.86億美元。
新台幣今日以32.25元、升值2.8分開出，最高來到32.2元，全日高低價差6分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元貶值約0.4%表現較弱，星元貶近0.1%，日元小貶不到0.05%，美元指數微升0.02%上下，人民幣處平盤，新台幣收升0.1%，泰銖則升約0.15%。
元大投顧認為，由於美伊和談進展轉趨悲觀，投資人仍需心存謹慎以因應突發狀況，同時，市場觀望美國將公布CPI數據。
國泰證期研究部指出，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，投資人謹慎等待美國CPI，若高於預期恐干擾後續降息步調。
統一投顧則分析，隨著國際原油價格由高峰顯著回落，今日將公布的美國CPI 數據可望進一步降溫。
paras_en: The Taiwan dollar strengthened today as foreign investors continued to buy stocks, closing at NT$32.246, up 3.2 points, with a total transaction value of US$13.86 billion by Taipei foreign exchange brokers.
The Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.25, up 2.8 points, and reached a high of NT$32.2, with a daily high-low price difference of 6 points.

Major Asian currencies showed mixed performances, with the Korean won depreciating by about 0.4%, the Singapore dollar depreciating by nearly 0.1%, the Japanese yen depreciating by less than 0.05%, and the US dollar index rising by 0.02%, while the Chinese yuan remained flat, the Taiwan dollar rose by 0.1%, and the Thai baht rose by about 0.15%.

Yuanta Securities believes that due to the increasingly pessimistic outlook for US-Iran talks, investors should remain cautious and prepared for unexpected situations, while also awaiting the release of US CPI data.

The research department of CTBC Securities noted that market sentiment is tense, with investors waiting cautiously for the release of US CPI data, which may disrupt the subsequent interest rate reduction schedule if it exceeds expectations.
United Securities analyzed that with international crude oil prices significantly declining from their peak, today's release of US CPI data is expected to further cool down the market.

items.title: CoCo壹番屋成經濟指標！美策略師創「咖哩豬排指數」：日元遭嚴重低估 兌美元公允價應為62.18
items.title_en: Coco Ichibanya Becomes Economic Indicator! US Strategist Creates 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index': Yen Severely Undervalued, Fair Value Against Dollar Should Be 62.18
paras: 紐約梅隆銀行高級策略師 Geoff Yu 以日式「咖哩豬排飯」為基準創建「咖哩豬排指數」，試圖更精準捕捉日元貶值對日本民眾的實際痛感。
相較於漢堡，咖哩飯作為日本國民主食，更能反映日常物價與購買力的真實變化，因此「咖哩豬排指數」被視為《經濟學人》「大麥克指數」的本土化替代指標，
日元兌美元匯率在今 (12) 日亞洲早盤交易時段徘徊在 159.23 的數十年低點附近，意味著在市場定價下，1 美元可兌換近 159 日元，但 Yu 以全球最大咖哩連鎖 CoCo 壹番屋的跨國售價計算，考量日元在日本國內的實際購買力後，1 美元公允價值僅應兌換 62.18 日元。這一數據顯示，當前匯市對日元低估程度遠超過大麥克指數所暗示的 80.3 日元。
Yu 指出，若政策目標是將日本購買力對齊其他高收入國家，日元匯價遠未達到合理水平。
「咖哩豬排指數」凸顯出日本官方干預匯市與實體經濟感受之間的落差。
儘管東京當局近期出手支撐日元，但在連鎖餐飲價格的鏡像下，日元在日本國內的實質價值被嚴重低估，民眾生活成本壓力遠高於匯率數字呈現的表象。
paras_en: New York Mellon Bank senior strategist Geoff Yu created the 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' based on Japanese-style curry rice, trying to more accurately capture the actual pain felt by Japanese citizens from yen depreciation.

Compared to burgers, curry rice is Japan's national staple food, and it can better reflect the real changes in daily prices and purchasing power, so the 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' is seen as a domesticized alternative to the Economist's Big Mac Index.

The yen's exchange rate against the US dollar hovered around a 159.23 level in the Asian early trading session on the 12th, indicating that 1 US dollar can be exchanged for nearly 159 yen in market pricing, but Yu calculated the fair value of 1 US dollar to be only 62.18 yen based on the global largest curry chain CoCo Ichibanya's cross-border sales prices, considering the actual purchasing power of the yen in Japan.
Yu pointed out that if the policy goal is to align Japan's purchasing power with other high-income countries, the yen's exchange rate is far from reaching a reasonable level.
The 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' highlights the gap between the Japanese government's intervention in the foreign exchange market and the actual feelings of the economy.

Although the Tokyo authorities have recently stepped in to support the yen, the yen's actual value in Japan is severely undervalued in the mirror of chain restaurant prices, and the pressure on people's living costs is far higher than the appearance presented by the exchange rate numbers.

items.title: 匯率同盟背後暗藏裂痕！美財長催「升」、日相想寬鬆撐經濟 日元160大關再度告急
items.title_en: Rifts beneath the Currency Alliance: US Treasury Secretary pushes for 'up', Japan PM wants to ease to support economy. Yen at 160 big hurdle again.
paras: 美日兩國 7 月 31 日罕見聯手進場買日元，為 1998 年來美國首度協同干預匯市，一度將日元兌美元匯率從 164 附近拉回 155.2，但升幅迅速回吐，週二 (11 日) 再度逼近 1 美元兌 160 日元心理關卡。市場目光隨即轉向美日一條隱形裂痕。
美國財長貝森特長期主張「升息才是救日元根本」，日相高市早苗卻忌憚利率過快上升扼殺經濟復甦，政策協調面臨「匯率干預強、貨幣緊縮弱」的背離。
自高市去年 10 月執政以來，日本央行 (BOJ) 僅升息兩次，基準利率停在 1% 低檔。
就在美國 7 月底買日元當天，BOJ 卻按兵不動。對此法巴資管經理 Peter Vassallo 表示，那一週錯失「黃金機會」。過往經驗顯示，欲扭轉市場心理往往需要匯率干預與貨幣緊縮同步出擊。
RBC 固收投資長 Dowding 點破兩難，高市早苗想寬鬆支撐經濟成長，但日元弱推升進口通膨會反噬其支持度。若 BOJ 下月或 10 月不升息、日元續跌，「市場將判定干預失敗」。
目前，市場預估 BOJ 在 9 月 17-18 日會議升息的機率逾 60%，若成真將是 BOJ 自 1989 年資產泡沫頂峰以來首見「12 個月內連續三度升息」。
美國官員表示，貝森特與高市立場「相左」說法過度簡化，雙方仍強調審慎溝通、限制匯率過度波動、維繫雙邊經濟一致；但口徑統一掩不住實質張力，華府要 BOJ 分擔全球美元壓力，日本高市政府則想要保財政與選情。
短期來看，160 關口若再失守，聯合干預預期將重燃。長期來看，日美利差 (1% vs 3.5–3.75%) 不縮小，單靠外匯操作難改日元貶值底色，而這場「華府催升息、日相怕升息」的拉鋸才是決定日元能否真正築底的暗線。
paras_en: On July 31, the US and Japan jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market for the first time since 1998, buying yen and briefly pushing the yen-dollar exchange rate from around 164 to 155.2. However, the gains were quickly reversed, and the yen-dollar exchange rate approached the psychological barrier of 160 yen per dollar again on Tuesday (11th). Market attention then shifted to a hidden rift between the US and Japan.

US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has long advocated for 'raising interest rates as the fundamental solution to save the yen', while Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida is wary of rapid interest rate hikes that could strangle economic recovery. Policy coordination is facing a 'strong intervention in exchange rates and weak monetary tightening' divergence.
Since Kishida took office in October last year, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) has only raised interest rates twice, keeping the benchmark interest rate at a low of 1%.

On the day the US intervened in the yen market at the end of July, the BOJ remained inactive. Faber Asset Management Manager Peter Vassallo said that the missed 'golden opportunity' that week. Past experience has shown that turning around market psychology often requires simultaneous intervention in exchange rates and monetary tightening.

RBC Fixed Income Investment Manager Dowding pointed out the dilemma: Kishida wants to ease to support economic growth, but a weak yen will push up import inflation, which will undermine his support. If the BOJ does not raise interest rates in September or October and the yen continues to fall, 'the market will judge the intervention as a failure'.

Currently, the market estimates that the BOJ will raise interest rates at the September 17-18 meeting with a probability of over 60%. If it happens, it will be the BOJ's first 'three consecutive interest rate hikes within 12 months' since the asset bubble peak in 1989.

US officials say that the statement that Yellen and Kishida have 'differing views' is oversimplified, and both sides emphasize prudent communication, limiting excessive exchange rate fluctuations, and maintaining bilateral economic consistency; however, the verbal unity cannot hide the underlying tension. Washington wants the BOJ to share the global dollar pressure, while the Japanese government wants to preserve its fiscal and electoral interests.

In the short term, if the 160 yen barrier is breached again, the expectation of joint intervention will be rekindled. In the long term, the yen-dollar interest rate differential (1% vs 3.5-3.75%) will not narrow, and relying solely on foreign exchange operations will be difficult to change the underlying devaluation of the yen. This 'Washington pushes for interest rate hikes, Tokyo fears interest rate hikes' tug-of-war is the underlying line that will determine whether the yen can truly bottom out.

items.title: 日元到底有多弱？「豬排咖哩指數」算出1美元只值62日元
items.title_en: How Weak is the Yen? "Katsu Curry Index" Calculates 1 US Dollar Equals 62 Japanese Yen
paras: 紐約梅隆銀行（BNY Mellon）一名資深策略師，正透過日本平價美食「豬排咖哩」的價格，衡量日元究竟有多疲弱。在近期匯市干預效果逐漸消退之際，這項指標試圖更貼近日本民眾對日元貶值的實際感受。
該行策略師 Geoff Yu 建立「豬排咖哩指數」（Katsu Curry Index），作為「大麥克指數」（Big Mac Index）的替代指標。
他認為，與其比較各國漢堡價格，不如以豬排、米飯與咖哩組成的日式國民美食進行國際價格比較，更能反映日元貶值對日本民眾購買力的影響。
在週三 (12 日) 早晨的全球外匯市場中，一美元約可兌換 159.23 日元。然而，根據 Geoff Yu 將豬排咖哩價格所反映出的日元購買力納入計算，一美元其實僅能兌換 62.18 日元。
這顯示外匯市場嚴重低估了日元的價值。相較之下，基於跨國麥當勞漢堡價格的大麥克指數則指出，一美元應可兌換 80.30 日元。
Yu 表示：「如果目標是讓購買力與高所得國家看齊，這項指數顯示，日元必須大幅升值。」他的計算採用全球最大咖哩飯連鎖品牌 CoCo 壹番屋的價格資料，該品牌在全球約有 1,500 家門市。
日本與美國政府日前採取 15 年來最具規模的匯市干預行動，試圖將日元從兌美元近 40 年低點拉回，使日元成為全球外匯市場焦點。然而，日元此後已回吐干預帶來的約一半漲幅。
日元處於歷史低檔，不僅讓許多日本民眾出國旅遊與購買進口商品的成本大幅增加，隨著餐飲、服務及消費品價格上漲，日常生活支出也受到衝擊。
Yu 表示：「如果在日本吃一份豬排咖哩或一碗拉麵，都變得貴到令人難以負擔，要求政策轉向的聲音可能就會愈來愈大。」
以購買力平價為基礎的替代指數還有很多。例如，「大杯拿鐵指數」（Tall Latte Index）追蹤星巴克咖啡在全球各地的售價；「肯德基指數」（KFC Index）則是為了更準確衡量非洲地區的購買力平價而設計，因為大麥克在當地市場的普及程度相對較低。
paras_en: A senior strategist at New York Mellon Bank (BNY Mellon) is using the price of a Japanese comfort food, "Katsu Curry," to gauge the yen's weakness. As the impact of recent currency intervention begins to fade, this index aims to better reflect Japanese people's actual feelings about yen depreciation.
The strategist, Geoff Yu, created the "Katsu Curry Index" as an alternative to the "Big Mac Index."

He believes that comparing the prices of burgers in different countries is not as effective as comparing the prices of a Japanese national dish made of pork cutlet, rice, and curry to reflect the impact of yen depreciation on Japanese people's purchasing power.

In the global foreign exchange market on Wednesday morning (12th), one US dollar was equivalent to approximately 159.23 Japanese yen. However, according to Geoff Yu's calculation, which incorporates the purchasing power of Katsu Curry, one US dollar can only be exchanged for 62.18 Japanese yen.

This shows that the foreign exchange market has severely underestimated the value of the yen. In comparison, the Big Mac Index, based on the prices of McDonald's burgers across countries, suggests that one US dollar should be equivalent to 80.30 Japanese yen.

Yu said, "If the goal is to make purchasing power comparable to high-income countries, this index shows that the yen must appreciate significantly." His calculation uses the price data of CoCo Ichibanya, the world's largest curry rice chain, which has approximately 1,500 outlets globally.

The Japanese and US governments recently took the largest currency intervention in 15 years to try to bring the yen back from its near 40-year low against the US dollar, making the yen a focal point in the global foreign exchange market. However, the yen has since given back about half of the appreciation brought by the intervention.

The yen is at a historical low, not only increasing the cost of travel and imported goods for many Japanese people, but also affecting daily living expenses as food, service, and consumer goods prices rise.
Yu said, "If eating a Katsu Curry or a bowl of ramen in Japan becomes so expensive that it's hard to bear, the voices calling for a policy shift may become louder."

There are many alternative indices based on purchasing power parity, such as the "Tall Latte Index," which tracks the prices of Starbucks coffee in different locations, and the "KFC Index," designed to more accurately measure purchasing power parity in Africa, where McDonald's is less popular.

items.title: 人民幣兌美元即期匯率創42個月新高 下半年人民幣有望緩步走升
items.title_en: RMB Exchange Rate Against USD Hits 42-Month High, Expected to Gradually Appreciate in 2H
paras: 人民幣兌美元即期匯率 10 日（周一）盤中最高升至 6.7439，創下 2023 年 2 月 6 日以來 3 年多新高，今年以來累計升值幅度接近 3.5%。
人民幣兌美元中間價同日調升 20 個基點，報 6.7884，寫下 2023 年 2 月 10 日以來最高，今年來累計升值 3.42%。
工銀亞洲認為，下半年人民幣可能會延續波動、緩步走升態勢，出口韌性增長、國際資金增配人民幣資產等因素將支撐中樞走強。
民生銀行經濟學家團隊指出，出口高景氣是今年支撐匯率走強的主要動力，預計 8 月人民幣匯率將在 6.75 附近維持平穩雙向波動。
paras_en: The RMB exchange rate against the USD reached a 42-month high on Monday, with the highest point at 6.7439, marking a new high since February 6, 2023, with a cumulative appreciation of nearly 3.5% so far this year.

The central parity of the RMB against the USD was adjusted up by 20 basis points to 6.7884 on the same day, hitting the highest level since February 10, 2023, with a cumulative appreciation of 3.42% this year.

ICBC Asia believes that in the second half of the year, the RMB may continue to fluctuate and gradually appreciate, supported by factors such as the resilience of exports and the increase in international funds allocated to RMB assets.

The economics team at Minsheng Bank pointed out that the high export boom is the main driving force behind the strong exchange rate this year, and it is expected that the RMB exchange rate will remain stable with two-way fluctuations around 6.75 in August.
